qe: What is 'Fiat Money'?
qh: 'फिएट मनी' (Fiat Money) क्या है?
e: Fiat money aisi mudra hoti hai jise sarkar ke aadesh ya kanoon se chalan mein laaya jaata hai tatha uske peeche sone ya chandi jaisi koi asli cheez nahi hoti. Pehle vikalp mein fiat money ki baat sahi kahi gayi hai. Aaj bharat ka har note tatha sikka isi shreni mein aata hai; isliye uski keemat janta ke bharose tatha sarkar ke niyam par tiki rehti hai, tatha RBI jitne note chahe chhaap sakti hai, halaanki zyada chhaapne se mehngai badh jaati hai. Apni keemat wali mudra jaise purane sone-chandi ke sikke tatha bank ka cheque is shreni mein nahi aate, kyonki cheque to keval bhugtan ka aadesh hai. fiat money ke alawa baaki sab vikalp galat hain. Exam point: fiat money keval sarkar ke aadesh se chalti hai - isliye uski keemat sone se nahi, bharose se banti hai.

qe: What is the 'Repo Rate' in the Indian Economy?
qh: भारतीय अर्थव्यवस्था में 'रेपो रेट' क्या है?
o: Rate at which RBI lends to commercial banks
Rate at which banks lend to public
Rate at which RBI borrows from banks
e: Repo rate us dar ko kaha jaata hai jis par vyaaparik bankon ko RBI se chhote samay ka udhaar milta hai, tatha badle mein sarkari kagaz girvi rakhe jaate hain. Pehle vikalp mein chhote samay ke udhaar ki baat sahi kahi gayi hai. Isse mahange ya saste karz ka pura bazaar chalta hai; isliye jab mehngai badhti hai to repo rate badhaya jaata hai jisse bankon ka karz mahanga ho jaye tatha bazaar mein paisa kam ho jaye. Aam janta ko bank jis dar par karz dete hain wo asli karz dar hai, mehngai ka aakda alag hota hai tatha apne paas jama rakhi rakam par bank jo byaj paate hain wo alag vishay hai. chhote samay ke udhaar ke alawa baaki sab vikalp galat hain. Exam point: repo rate RBI ka wo hathiyar hai jisse bankon ko chhote samay ka paisa milta hai - isi se bazaar mein paise ki dhaar tay hoti hai.

qe: Who is the 'Lender of Last Resort' in the Indian financial system?
qh: भारतीय वित्तीय प्रणाली में 'अंतिम ऋणदाता' (Lender of Last Resort) कौन है?
e: Antim rin data yaani Lender of Last Resort wo bada bank hota hai jo sankat ke samay doosre bankon ko paisa de kar unhe doobne se bachaata hai, tatha bharat mein yah kaam RBI karta hai. Chauthe vikalp mein RBI ka antim rin data ki baat sahi kahi gayi hai. Yah bhumika isliye zaroori hai ki kisi bade bank ke doobne se doosre bhi doob sakte hain; isliye RBI unhe udhar de kar tatha unka hisaab dekhe rakhe rakam ka bharosa banaye rakhti hai. Vitta mantralaya sarkar ka khata dekhta hai, SBI ek aam bada bank hai tatha World Bank baahar ke deshon ko karz deta hai, isliye koi bhi yahan antim rin data nahi hai. RBI ka antim rin data ke alawa baaki sab vikalp galat hain. Exam point: antim rin data RBI hoti hai - isi par bankon ka aakhri sahara tika hota hai.

qe: What is 'Narrow Money' in the context of RBI's classification?
qh: RBI के वर्गीकरण के संदर्भ में 'नैरो मनी' क्या है?
e: Narrow money yaani M1 RBI ke vargikaran mein chalan mein maujood note-sikke tatha bankon ke paas jama chalu khaaton ka paisa joda jaata hai, isliye yah turant kharch hone wala paisa dikhata hai. Pehle vikalp mein narrow money M1 ki baat sahi kahi gayi hai. Yah ginti isliye kaam aati hai ki ismein sirf wahi paisa aata hai jo log pal bhar mein kharch kar sakte hain, isliye mehngai tatha aay ki garmi ka andaza isse saaf lagta hai. M3 mein booso jama bhi judte hain, M4 mein dak khate ki bachat bhi aati hai tatha M2 mein M1 ke saath bachat jama jode jaate hain, isliye yah baaki teeno narrow money ke nahi hain. narrow money M1 ke alawa baaki sab vikalp galat hain. Exam point: narrow money M1 hai - ismein keval chalan wala paisa aata hai.

qe: What does 'CRR' stand for in Banking?
qh: बैंकिंग में 'CRR' का क्या अर्थ है?
e: CRR yaani Cash Reserve Ratio ke tahat har vyaaparik bank ko apne jama paise ka ek hissa RBI ke paas bina byaj jama rakhna padta hai. Chauthe vikalp mein RBI ke paas bina byaj jama rakhi rakam ki baat sahi kahi gayi hai. Is niyam isliye banaya gaya ki bankon ke paas kam se kam rakam to hamesha bache; isliye RBI is dar ko badha kar bazaar se paisa kheench sakti hai tatha ghata kar khapat tez kar sakti hai. Capital ka matlab bank ki apni punji hoti hai, currency reserve koi shabd nahi hai tatha credit yaani karz ki dar alag vishay hai, isliye yah sahi naam nahi hain. RBI ke paas bina byaj jama rakhi rakam ke alawa baaki sab vikalp galat hain. Exam point: CRR mein jama paise ka ek hissa bankon ko RBI ke paas rakha rakhna padta hai - is par koi byaj nahi milta.

qe: What is 'Reverse Repo Rate'?
qh: 'रिवर्स रेपो रेट' क्या है?
o: Rate RBI pays to banks for their deposits
e: Reverse repo rate par RBI bankon se unka paisa apne paas jama kar leti hai tatha badle mein unhe byaj deti hai. Chauthe vikalp mein RBI dwara paisa kheenchne ka rasta ki baat sahi kahi gayi hai. Iska istemal wahin hota hai jab bazaar mein bahut jyada paisa hone se mehngai ka khatra badh jaye; isliye RBI paisa kheenchne ke liye yah dar tay karti hai tatha bank apna bacha paisa yahan rakh kar byaj kamate hain. Aam janta ko milne wala byaj, bankon ko repo rate par milne wala karz tatha GST ki dar alag vishay hain, isliye yah teeno is shabd ke kareeb nahi. RBI dwara paisa kheenchne ka rasta ke alawa baaki sab vikalp galat hain. Exam point: reverse repo mein RBI bankon se udhar leti hai - isse bazaar ki taralta ghatti hai.

qe: Which bank is known as the 'Banker's Bank' in India?
qh: भारत में किस बैंक को 'बैंकर्स बैंक' कहा जाता है?
e: Bankon ka bank wo sanstha hoti hai jo doosre bankon ke liye bank ka kaam karti hai, tatha bharat mein yah pad RBI ka hai. Doosre vikalp mein RBI ka bankon ka bank ki baat sahi kahi gayi hai. Yah isliye zaroori hai ki aam bank apna paisa RBI ke paas rakhte hain tatha zarurat padne par udhar lete hain; isliye unka hisaab, niyaman tatha safai ka kaam bhi wahin hota hai. SBI, PNB tatha HDFC aam grahakon ke liye kaam karne wale bank hain, isliye yah bade hokar bhi bankon ke bank nahi ban paate. RBI ka bankon ka bank ke alawa baaki sab vikalp galat hain. Exam point: bankon ka bank RBI hai - yahi bankon ka hisaab tatha unki madad dekhti hai.

qe: Where is the headquarter of RBI located?
qh: RBI का मुख्यालय कहाँ स्थित है?
e: RBI ka mukhya daftar Mumbai mein sthit hai tatha yahin se bharat ki mudra niti chalayi jaati hai. Teesre vikalp mein Mumbai ka mukhya daftar ki baat sahi kahi gayi hai. Yah kendra isliye ahem hai ki yahan nideshak mandal baithkar repo rate tatha anya fainsle tay karta hai; isliye desh bhar ke bankon ke niyaman ka rasta isi sheher se chalta hai. Kolkata, Chennai tatha New Delhi mein RBI ke khaas daftar zaroor hain par mukhya daftar nahi hai, isliye yah anya sheher ke naam hain. Mumbai ka mukhya daftar ke alawa baaki sab vikalp galat hain. Exam point: RBI ka mukhya daftar Mumbai mein hai - yahin se mudra niti ke fainsle hote hain.

qe: Which is the largest public sector bank in India?
qh: भारत का सबसे बड़ा सार्वजनिक क्षेत्र का बैंक कौन सा है?
e: SBI bharat ka sabse bada sarvajanik kshetra ka bank hai, jiske sabse zyada shaakhaayein tatha jama paise hain. Teesre vikalp mein SBI ka badapan ki baat sahi kahi gayi hai. Yah bada aakaar isliye bana ki samaaveshan ke baad usmein desh ke kai bade bank jude; isliye uski pakad gaon-sheher dono mein bani hui hai tatha sarkari yojnaon ka paisa bhi yahin se chalta hai. Canara Bank, PNB tatha Bank of Baroda bade sarvajanik bank hain par sabse bade nahi, isliye badapan inmein kisi ka nahi hai. SBI ka badapan ke alawa baaki sab vikalp galat hain. Exam point: sabse bada sarvajanik bank SBI hai - yahi jama tatha shaakhaon mein sabse aage hai.

qe: What is the 'Full Form' of SDR in the context of IMF?
qh: IMF के संदर्भ में SDR का 'पूर्ण रूप' क्या है?
e: SDR ka poora naam Special Drawing Rights hai, tatha yah IMF dwara banaya gaya ek aisa bharosa hai jise sone ya mudra ki tarah deshon ke bazaar mein kaam mein liya jaata hai. Teesre vikalp mein Special Drawing Rights ki baat sahi kahi gayi hai. Yah bharosa isliye kaam aata hai ki jis desh ke paas apni mudra ki dikkat ho wo doosre deshon se yah lekar apna hisaab chuka sakta hai; isliye yah IMF ke sadasya deshon ke bich bani ek khaas karz-den ki soochi hai. Special Deposit Ratio tatha Standard Debt Rate jaise naam is shabd ke nahi hain tatha koi nahi wala vikalp bhi galat hai, isliye yah sahi naam nahi hain. Special Drawing Rights ke alawa baaki sab vikalp galat hain. Exam point: SDR ka poora naam Special Drawing Rights hai - yah IMF ka ek khaas bharosa-patra hai.

qe: Which currency has the highest 'Weightage' in the SDR basket?
qh: SDR बास्केट में किस मुद्रा का 'वेटेज' सबसे अधिक है?
e: SDR ke jhode mein sabse zyada wazan ameriki dollar ka hai, jo karib bayalis pratishat ke aas-paas rehta hai. Chauthe vikalp mein dollar ka sabse bada wazan ki baat sahi kahi gayi hai. Yah badi hissa isliye mila ki duniya ka sabse bada karobar tatha tel-sona ka bazaar dollar mein hi chalta hai; isliye IMF bhi apne is khaas bharose ki keemat tay karne ke liye dollar ko sabse zyada jagah deta hai. Japanese yen, euro tatha chinese yuan bhi jhode mein shaamil hain par unka wazan dollar se kam hai, isliye sabse bada hissa inmein kisi ka nahi hai. dollar ka sabse bada wazan ke alawa baaki sab vikalp galat hain. Exam point: SDR jhode mein sabse bada hissa dollar ka hai - yahi uski sabse ahem mudra hai.

qe: What is 'Seigniorage' in banking and currency?
qh: बैंकिंग और मुद्रा में 'सीनियरिज' (Seigniorage) क्या है?
o: Profit made by the govt by issuing currency
e: Seigniorage ka matlab hai mudra jaari karne wali sarkar ya bank ko jo labh hota hai, kyonki note banane ki laagat uske mulya se bahut kam padti hai. Doosre vikalp mein seigniorage ka labh ki baat sahi kahi gayi hai. Yah labh isliye banta hai ki sau rupaye ka note chhapne mein kuch paise hi lagte hain par uski keemat sau rupaye mani jaati hai; isliye bachaya hua paisa sarkar ki aay ka ek khufiya zariya banta hai. Bank ka shulk tatha buzurgon ka kar is vishay se door hain, aur koi nahi wala vikalp bhi galat hai. seigniorage ka labh ke alawa baaki sab vikalp galat hain. Exam point: seigniorage mudra chhapne ka labh hai - yahi sarkar aur bank sambhalte hain.

qe: What is 'Capital Buffer' under Basel III norms?
qh: बेसल III मानदंडों के तहत 'पूंजी बफर' क्या है?
o: Mandatory extra capital banks must keep for crises
e: Bahs III ke niyam ke tahat capital buffer wo badhi punji hai jo bankon ko sankat ke samay ke liye apne paas rakhni padti hai. Chauthe vikalp mein badhi punji ka capital buffer ki baat sahi kahi gayi hai. Yah jog isliye rakha jaata hai ki mandi tatha badi udhar-phansne wali haalat mein bank doob na jaye; isliye bazaar tej chalne par jamaye gaye is punji se sankat ke samay ka bojh sambhala jaata hai. Locker ka shulk tatha badhi kar is vishay se ghalat hain, koi nahi bhi galat hai. badhi punji ka capital buffer ke alawa baaki sab vikalp galat hain. Exam point: capital buffer mandi ke liye bachayi gayi badhi punji hai - isse bank tike rehte hain.

qe: What is 'Broad Money' (M3) formula?
qh: 'व्यापक मुद्रा' (M3) का सूत्र क्या है?
e: M3 yaani vyaapak mudra nikalne ke liye M1 mein bankon ki samay-wali jama yaani fixed deposit jodi jaati hai. Doosre vikalp mein M3 ka sootr ki baat sahi kahi gayi hai. Yah ganit isliye maayne rakhta hai ki ismein chalan wala paisa tatha bachat dono shaamil hain; isliye bazaar mein kul kitna paisa tayyar hai, iska sabse bharosemand andaaza isse lagta hai. M1 mein dak-ghar ki bachat jodna, M2 mein sona jodna tatha koi nahi wala vikalp M3 ke sahi sootr nahi hain. M3 ka sootr ke alawa baaki sab vikalp galat hain. Exam point: M3 ka sootr M1 plus samay-jama hai - yahi vyaapak mudra kahlati hai.

qe: What is 'White Label ATM' (WLA)?
qh: 'व्हाइट लेबल एटीएम' (WLA) क्या है?
o: ATMs owned and operated by non-banking companies
e: White label ATM yaani WLA wo khada hai jo bank ke nahi, balki kisi gair-banking company ke bandobast se chalaya jaata hai tatha wahan se bhi paisa nikala ja sakta hai. Teesre vikalp mein gair-banking company ka ATM ki baat sahi kahi gayi hai. Yah suvidha isliye shuru hui ki gaon tatha chhote sheher mein bankon ke apne machine kam the; isliye kisi bhi bank ke grahak ko yahan se cash mil jaata hai, halaanki raashi ke antim uthane wala bank dekh lete hain. RBI ke apne khade tatha muft machine wale vikalp is vishay se behtar nahi hain, koi nahi bhi galat hai. gair-banking company ka ATM ke alawa baaki sab vikalp galat hain. Exam point: white label ATM gair-banking company chalati hai - isse baahar tatha gaon mein cash ki suvidha badhi.

qe: Which sector is 'Payment Aggregator' part of?
qh: 'पेमेंट एग्रीगेटर' किस क्षेत्र का हिस्सा है?
e: Payment aggregator ka kaam digital karobar ke liye bhugtan ki suvidha dena hai, isliye yah sevaon wale teesre kshetra ka ek hissa hai. Pehle vikalp mein payment aggregator ki seva ki baat sahi kahi gayi hai. Bina yah kadi ke online dukaan, app tatha hotal bhugtan sweekar nahi kar paate; isliye karobar badhne ke saath inki ginti tatha kaam tez hota hai, tatha yah khud bhi sewa hi pradan karti hai. Kheti wala prathmik kshetra tatha factory wala doosra kshetra bana hua maal paida karte hain, tatha koi nahi wala vikalp galat hai. payment aggregator ki seva ke alawa baaki sab vikalp galat hain. Exam point: payment aggregator sevaon wale teesre kshetra mein aata hai - yahi digital bhugtan ki kadi hai.

qe: What is 'Ways and Means Advances' (WMA)?
qh: 'वेज़ एंड मीन्स एडवांसेज' (WMA) क्या है?
o: Short-term loan from RBI to Govt to meet cash flow mismatch
e: Ways and Means Advances yaani WMA RBI dwara sarkar ko diya jaane wala chhote samay ka karz hai, jo aay tatha kharch ke beech phaasla poora karne ke liye hota hai. Chauthe vikalp mein WMA ka chhota udhar ki baat sahi kahi gayi hai. Sarkar ke khaate mein mahine ke shuru mein kharch jyada tatha aay kam hoti hai; isliye is ashaantulan ko poora karne ke liye thode dino ka udhar milta hai, jise tay samay par chukana padta hai. Sarkari tankha tatha muft kosh wale vikalp yahan chalte nahi hain, koi nahi bhi galat hai. WMA ka chhota udhar ke alawa baaki sab vikalp galat hain. Exam point: WMA sarkar ke cash ki kami ka chhota udhar hai - ise chukana zaroori hota hai.

qe: What is 'Core Banking Solution' (CBS)?
qh: 'कोर बैंकिंग समाधान' (CBS) क्या है?
o: Networking of branches to allow 'Anywhere Banking'
e: Core banking solution yaani CBS ek network vyavastha hai jisse bank ki saari shaakhaayein ek doosre se jud jaati hain tatha kisi bhi shaakha se khaata chalaya ja sakta hai. Doosre vikalp mein CBS ka network ki baat sahi kahi gayi hai. Yah vyavastha isliye laayi gayi ki pehle khaata jis shaakha mein tha wahin se kaam hota tha; isliye ab kisi bhi sheher mein jama-tod tatha bhugtan ho jaata hai, isse samay tatha kaagaz dono bachte hain. Locker ki sewa tatha keval gaon ke bankon wala vikalp is shabd ke kareeb nahi, koi nahi bhi galat hai. CBS ka network ke alawa baaki sab vikalp galat hain. Exam point: CBS se saari shaakhaayein jud jaati hain - isse kahin bhi khaata chal jaata hai.

qe: During which plan was 'NABARD' established?
qh: 'नाबार्ड' (NABARD) की स्थापना किस योजना के दौरान हुई थी?
e: NABARD ki sthapna chhahve panchvarshiya yojna ke dauran hui thi tatha isne gaon-wale karz tatha kheti ki vyavastha sambhali. Pehle vikalp mein chhahve panchvarshiya yojna ki baat sahi kahi gayi hai. Yah samay isliye ahem hai ki tab gaon ki suvidha tatha kheti ke liye alag karkhane ki zarurat thi; isliye NABARD banne ke baad se sahkaari bankon tatha RRB ko taakat mili tatha kisaano ko sasta karz pahuncha. Koi nahi, doosri tatha chauthe panchvarshiya yojna wale vikalp is sthapna ke samay ke nahi hain. chhahve panchvarshiya yojna ke alawa baaki sab vikalp galat hain. Exam point: NABARD chhahve panchwalsi (1982) mein bana - yahi gaon-wale karz ka bada sahara hai.

qe: What is 'Statutory Liquidity Ratio' (SLR) maintained in?
qh: 'साविधिक तरलता अनुपात' (SLR) किसमें रखा जाता है?
e: SLR ke niyam ke tahat bankon ko apne jama paise ka ek hissa nakad, sone tatha sarkari karz-patraon yaani government securities ke roop mein rakhna padta hai. Teesre vikalp mein nakad, sone tatha sarkari kagaz ki baat sahi kahi gayi hai. Yah bandobast isliye kiya jaata hai ki bank ke paas chukane ka sahara bana rahe; isliye sarkar apne karz-patra bhi isi raste bikwa sakti hai tatha bankon ko sona tatha cash rakh rakhna padta hai. Keval videshi mudra tatha keval nakad wale vikalp is soochi mein nahi ginte. nakad, sone tatha sarkari kagaz ke alawa baaki sab vikalp galat hain. Exam point: SLR nakad, sona tatha sarkari kagaz mein rakhna hota hai - ise bank apne paas hi rakhte hain.

qe: Which bank is known as the 'Apex Bank' for Agriculture and Rural Development in India?
qh: भारत में कृषि और ग्रामीण विकास के लिए 'शीर्ष बैंक' कौन सा है?
e: Kheti tatha gaon ke vikas ke liye shikhar bank NABARD hai, jo in kshetron ke karz tatha yojnaon ka sabse bada sahara hai. Doosre vikalp mein NABARD ki shikhar bhumika ki baat sahi kahi gayi hai. Yah shikhar bhumika isliye bani ki gaon-wale karz tatha kheti ke liye alag dekhabhal chahiye; isliye NABARD ke zariye cooperative banks tatha RRB ko sasta paisa milta hai, jisse khade kaam tatha sinchai mein madad hoti hai. SBI ek aam vyaaparik bank hai, RBI mudra niti dekhti hai tatha IDBI udyogon ke kaam dekhta hai. NABARD ki shikhar bhumika ke alawa baaki sab vikalp galat hain. Exam point: kheti tatha gaon ka shikhar NABARD hai - yahi sasta karz pahunchata hai.

qe: Which committee recommended the establishment of 'RRBs' (Regional Rural Banks)?
qh: किस समिति ने 'RRB' (क्षेत्रीय ग्रामीण बैंकों) की स्थापना की सिफारिश की थी?
e: RRB yaani kshetriya gaon-wale bankon ki sthapna ki salah Narasimham samiti ne di thi tatha pehla RRB 1975 mein bana tha. Doosre vikalp mein Narasimham samiti ki salah ki baat sahi kahi gayi hai. Yah soch isliye bani ki bade sheher ke bank gaon tatha chhoti mandi tak nahi pahunch paate the; isliye RRB ko ek disha mein kaam karne ki chhoot di gayi, jisse gaon ke kisaan tatha hunarkar ko aasan karz mila. Shivaraman samiti anya vishay dekhti hai, Hilton Young ayog purane bank ke vishay mein thi tatha koi nahi wala vikalp galat hai. Narasimham samiti ki salah ke alawa baaki sab vikalp galat hain. Exam point: RRB ka sujhav Narasimham samiti ne diya - yahi gaon ke banking ka bada kadam tha.

qe: What is 'Monetary Policy' primarily used to control?
qh: 'मौद्रिक नीति' का उपयोग मुख्य रूप से किसे नियंत्रित करने के लिए किया जाता है?
e: Mudra niti ka mukhya kaam mehngai tatha paise ki aapurti par lagam rakhna hai, jisse desh mein keematon ki sthirta bani rahe. Doosre vikalp mein mehngai tatha aapurti par lagam ki baat sahi kahi gayi hai. Iska lakshya isliye tay hota hai ki tej mehngai tatha ghatti-badhti paise ki matra dono aam aadmi tatha karobar ko nuksan pahunchate hain; isliye RBI dar ko is tarah chalati hai ki khapat sahi rehkar badhotri hulki rahe. Sarkari kharch tatha kar vitta niti ke vishay hain tatha videshi niti sarkar dekhti hai. mehngai tatha aapurti par lagam ke alawa baaki sab vikalp galat hain. Exam point: mudra niti ka lakshya mehngai tatha paise ki aapurti sambhalna hai - isse keemat sthir rehti hai.

qe: What is the 'Full Form' of LAF in RBI's monetary policy?
qh: RBI की मौद्रिक नीति में LAF का 'पूर्ण रूप' क्या है?
e: LAF ka poora naam Liquidity Adjustment Facility hai, tatha iske zariye RBI repo tatha reverse repo se chhote samay ke liye bazaar ki taralta tay karti hai. Pehle vikalp mein LAF ka cholha ki baat sahi kahi gayi hai. Yah cholha isliye kaam aata hai ki roz-marra ke karobar mein bankon ke paas paisa kam-jyada hota rehta hai; isliye din bhar mein LAF ke jariye paisa udhar-tod chalta rehta hai, isse byaj dar ek disha mein bandha rehta hai. Loan Against Finance tatha Local Asset Fund jaise naam is shabd ke nahi hain tatha koi nahi wala vikalp bhi galat hai. LAF ka cholha ke alawa baaki sab vikalp galat hain. Exam point: LAF ka poora naam Liquidity Adjustment Facility hai - isse roz ki taralta sambhali jaati hai.

qe: In India, 'Gilt-edged Market' refers to the market for:
qh: भारत में 'गिल्ट-एज्ड मार्केट' किसके बाजार को संदर्भित करता है?
e: Gilt-edged market sarkari karz-patraon ke kharid-farokht wale bazaar ko kaha jaata hai, jahan sarkar apne kagaz bechkar paisa jutati hai. Pehle vikalp mein sarkari kagaz ka bazaar ki baat sahi kahi gayi hai. Yah bazaar isliye sabse surakshit mana jaata hai ki ismein sarkar ka vaada rehta hai tatha doobne ka khatra na ke barabar hota hai; isliye bank tatha bade niveshkar apna paisa yahan laga kar byaj kamate hain. Sona-chandi tatha zameen ka bazaar is shabd se alag hai tatha koi nahi wala vikalp galat hai. sarkari kagaz ka bazaar ke alawa baaki sab vikalp galat hain. Exam point: gilt-edged market sarkari kagazon ka bazaar hai - yahi sabse surakshit bazaar mana jaata hai.

qe: Which bank is responsible for 'Issue of Currency Notes' in India?
qh: भारत में 'मुद्रा नोट जारी करने' के लिए कौन सा बैंक जिम्मेदार है?
e: Bharat mein mudra note jaari karne ka kaam RBI karta hai, jo sarkar ki taraf se note chhaapti tatha bazaar mein bhejti hai. Doosre vikalp mein RBI dwara note jaari karna ki baat sahi kahi gayi hai. Yah adhikar isliye keval RBI ke paas hai ki note chhapne se desh mein paise ki matra badhti hai tatha mehngai par asar padta hai; isliye chhapne ka faisla mudra niti ke saath mila hua hota hai. Koi nahi, SBI tatha IDBI is kaam ke sahi naam nahi hain - SBI keval sarkar ka aadesh poora karta hai. RBI dwara note jaari karna ke alawa baaki sab vikalp galat hain. Exam point: mudra note RBI jaari karti hai - yahi sarkar ki taraf se note chhaapne ka kaam karti hai.

qe: What is 'Foreign Exchange Reserves' (Forex) mainly composed of in India?
qh: भारत में 'विदेशी मुद्रा भंडार' मुख्य रूप से किससे बना है?
o: Foreign Currency Assets, Gold, SDRs and RTP
e: Bharat ka videshi mudra bhandar mukhya roop se videshi mudra ki sampatti, sona, SDR tatha reserve tranche position se banta hai. Teesre vikalp mein videshi mudra bhandar ka banao ki baat sahi kahi gayi hai. Yah bhandar isliye ahem hai ki aayat ke bade bhugtan tatha rupaye ki keemat sambhalne ka sahara yahin deta hai; isliye tan-mann se juda har desh apna bhandar bada rakhna chahta hai, tatha RBI isi se bazaar mein dollar bechkar rupaye ko thaame rakhti hai. Keval sona tatha keval dollar wale vikalp is bhandar ke sahi hisse nahi hain tatha koi nahi wala vikalp galat hai. videshi mudra bhandar ka banao ke alawa baaki sab vikalp galat hain. Exam point: videshi mudra bhandar videshi mudra, sona, SDR tatha RTP se banta hai - yahi bharat ki bahari taakat hai.

qe: What is the 'Full Form' of NABARD?
qh: NABARD का 'पूर्ण रूप' क्या है?
o: National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development
New Agency for Banking and Rural Development
e: NABARD ka poora naam National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development hai, tatha yahi gaon tatha kheti ke vikas ka shikhar bank hai. Teesre vikalp mein NABARD ka poora naam ki baat sahi kahi gayi hai. Yah naam isliye ahem hai ki ismein kheti tatha gaon ka vikas dono shaamil hain; isliye yah sanstha kheti ke karz, sinchai tatha gaon ke khade kaam ke liye paisa jutati tatha sahkaari sansthaon ke zariye pahunchati hai. Saare naam wala vikalp bhi galat hai tatha koi nahi bhi galat hai, isliye sirf ek hi naam is sanstha ka hai. NABARD ka poora naam ke alawa baaki sab vikalp galat hain. Exam point: NABARD ka poora naam National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development hai - yahi gaon tatha kheti ka shikhar bank hai.

qe: What is the 'Time Limit' for classifying a standard loan as an NPA?
qh: NPA के लिए 'समय सीमा' क्या है?
e: NPA yaani doobta karz wo karz hota hai jo karz lene wale ne tay samay tak nahi chukaya tatha uski asli wapasi ki ummeed kam ho jaati hai; bank ke niyam ke tahat 90 din tak bhugtan na aane par karz ko sanpa badha mana jaata hai. Doosre vikalp mein 90 din ki samay seema ki baat sahi kahi gayi hai. Yah seema isliye tay hui ki chhote samay ki deri aam baat hai; isliye 30 din par hi karz ko doobta maan lena bank karobar ke liye zyada sakht hota tatha 180 din ka intezaar karna bahut lamba, isliye beech ka rasta chuna gaya. Teen sau din ka intezaar karne se bank ki haalat chhup jaati tatha karz dene ki kshamta ghat jaati hai. 90 din ki samay seema ke alawa baaki sab vikalp galat hain. Exam point: NPA ki samay seema 90 din hai - ise poora hone par bank ko karz ke liye vyavastha karni padti hai.

qe: What is 'Monetary Base' also known as?
qh: 'मौद्रिक आधार' को और किस नाम से जाना जाता है?
e: Maudrik aadhar yaani monetary base wo kul paisa hota hai jismein bazaar mein chalan wala note-sikka tatha bankon ke paas RBI ke paas jama rakam shaamil hoti hai. Doosre vikalp mein High Powered Money M0 ki baat sahi kahi gayi hai. Ise High Powered Money isliye kaha jaata hai ki iska har rupaya bank ke karz ke zariye kaee gunna paisa paida kar sakta hai; isliye yah aadhar wali matra hoti hai jispar poora paisa-bazaar khada rehta hai. Broad money mein samay-jama bhi judti hai, koi nahi wala vikalp galat hai tatha plastic money ka card se koi ristha nahi. High Powered Money M0 ke alawa baaki sab vikalp galat hain. Exam point: maudrik aadhar ko High Powered Money M0 kaha jaata hai - yahi paise ke gunank ka aadhar hai.

qe: Which plan saw the introduction of 'Lead Bank Scheme'?
qh: किस योजना के दौरान 'लीड बैंक योजना' शुरू की गई थी?
e: Lead bank yojna wo tarika tha jismein har jile ke ek bank ko zila ka aguva bana diya gaya, jise wahan karz tatha bank suvidha badhane ki zimmewari di gayi; yah cholha chauthe paanch saal ki yojna ke dauran shuru hua. Chauthe vikalp mein chauthe panchvarshiya daur ki baat sahi kahi gayi hai. Yah yojna isliye laayi gayi ki ek hi jile mein kaee bank hone par bhi karz ki suvidha bahut kam thi; isliye aguva bank ko zila ka naksha tay karke bank shaakhaayein kholne tatha kisaano-hunarkaron tak karz pahunchane ki salah di gayi. Doosri, chhahvin tatha chauthe se alag koi bhi paanch saal ki yojna is cholhe ke samay se mel nahi khati. chauthe panchvarshiya daur ke alawa baaki sab vikalp galat hain. Exam point: lead bank yojna chauthe paanch saal ki yojna mein shuru hui - isse jila-wala banking ka kaam chala.

qe: Which 'Agency' issues 'Coins' in India?
qh: भारत में 'सिक्के' कौन जारी करता है?
e: Bharat mein note RBI jaari karti hai, par sikke vitta mantralaya jaari karta hai tatha yah kaam sikke ke kanoon ke tahat hota hai. Pehle vikalp mein vitta mantralaya dwara sikke ki baat sahi kahi gayi hai. Yah baant isliye ki gayi ki chhote sikke sarkar ki chhapai ke kaam hain tatha note ki matra par mehngai ka asar padta hai, isliye note chhapne ka adhikar RBI ke paas rakha gaya. RBI, SBI tatha minting board sirf chhapai ya sarkari kaam dekhte hain, isliye sikke jaari karne ka sahi naam inmein koi nahi hai. vitta mantralaya dwara sikke ke alawa baaki sab vikalp galat hain. Exam point: sikke tatha ek rupaye ka note vitta mantralaya jaari karta hai - yahi uski chhapai ki pehchan hai.

qe: What is the 'Fiscal Year' of RBI (aligned recently)?
qh: RBI का 'वित्तीय वर्ष' क्या है (हाल ही में संरेखित)?
e: RBI ka vittiya varsh April se shuru hota hai tatha ekatti March ko poora hota hai, tatha hala hi mein ise sarkar ke vittiya varsh ke saath jod diya gaya hai. Chauthe vikalp mein April se March ki baat sahi kahi gayi hai. Yah ek jaisa varsh isliye rakhna zaroori tha ki budget ke aakde tatha RBI ke hisaab ek hi avadhi ke mile; isliye pehle jo July se June wala chalan tha use badal kar sarkar ke saal ke barabar kar diya gaya. July se June, January se December tatha koi nahi wala vikalp is samay ke sahi nahi hain. April se March ke alawa baaki sab vikalp galat hain. Exam point: RBI ka vittiya varsh April se March hai - hala hi mein yah sarkar ke varsh ke saath joda gaya.

qe: Which organization provides 'Insurance' to depositors in banks up to 5 lakhs?
qh: बैंकों में जमाकर्ताओं को 5 लाख तक का 'बीमा' कौन प्रदान करता है?
e: Bankon mein rakhi jama ka bima DICGC yaani jama bima tatha rin guarantee nigam deta hai, tatha ek jama-karta ko ek bank mein paanch lakh rupaye tak ka bima milta hai. Chauthe vikalp mein DICGC ka bima ki baat sahi kahi gayi hai. Yah bima isliye diya jaata hai ki chhote jama-karta ka bharosa bana rahe tatha bank ke doobne par uska poora paisa na doob jaye; isliye yah sabhi vyaaparik bank tatha kuch anya bankon par lagta hai. SEBI bazaar dekhta hai, LIC jeevan bima bechti hai tatha RBI mudra niti chalati hai, isliye inmein se koi jama ka bima nahi deta. DICGC ka bima ke alawa baaki sab vikalp galat hain. Exam point: jama ka bima DICGC deta hai tatha iski seema paanch lakh rupaye hai - yahi chhote jama-karta ki dhaal hai.

qe: What is the main goal of 'Monetary Policy' in India?
qh: 'मौद्रिक नीति' का मुख्य लक्ष्य क्या है?
e: Maudrik niti ka mukhya lakshya mehngai par kaabu paana tatha saath hi badhotri ko sahara dena hota hai, jisse desh ki aam janta ki jeb surakshit rahe. Doosre vikalp mein keemat ki sthirta ki baat sahi kahi gayi hai. Is lakshya ke peeche yah vajah hai ki tej mehngai tatha bilkul thandi mandi dono nuksan karti hain; isliye RBI repo rate ko is tarah chalati hai ki mehngai apni seema mein rahe tatha kaam-rozgar bhi bante rahein. Kar badhana tatha niryat badhana sarkar ke anya kaam hain tatha koi nahi wala vikalp galat hai, isliye ve kaam inmein nahi hain. keemat ki sthirta ke alawa baaki sab vikalp galat hain. Exam point: maudrik niti ka mukhya lakshya keemat ki sthirta hai - isi ke saath badhotri ka saath chahiye.

qe: What is the 'Full Form' of UPI?
qh: UPI का 'पूर्ण रूप' क्या है?
e: UPI ka poora naam Unified Payments Interface hai, tatha yah NPCI dwara banaya gaya ek aisa manch hai jisse ek mobile app se banks ke khaaton mein seedha bhugtan hota hai. Chauthe vikalp mein Unified Payments Interface ki baat sahi kahi gayi hai. Yah manch isliye itna lokpriya hua ki ismein bank ka khaata tatha mobile jodkar pal bhar mein paisa bheja-leta ja sakta hai; isliye chhote dukaandar tatha aam log bhi bina card ke digital bhugtan kar lete hain. Universal Payment Interface, koi nahi tatha United Portal of India jaise naam is manch ke sahi nahi hain. Unified Payments Interface ke alawa baaki sab vikalp galat hain. Exam point: UPI ka poora naam Unified Payments Interface hai - yahi bharat ka bada digital bhugtan ka manch hai.

qe: What is the 'Full Form' of EEFC account?
qh: EEFC खाते का 'पूर्ण रूप' क्या है?
e: EEFC yaani Exchange Earners' Foreign Currency account wo khaata hai jismein niryatkar apni videshi mudra ki kamai ki kuch rakam rakh sakte hain. Doosre vikalp mein EEFC khaata ki baat sahi kahi gayi hai. Aisa bandobast isliye kiya gaya ki niryatkar ko videshi mudra mein hi bhugtan karne ki zarurat padti hai; isliye is khaate se wo bina baar-baar mudra badle apna karobar chala sakte hain tatha badlav ki laagat bach jaati hai. Koi nahi, External Export Finance Center tatha Easy Entry Financial Code jaise naam is khaate ke nahi hain. EEFC khaata ke alawa baaki sab vikalp galat hain. Exam point: EEFC khaata videshi mudra kamane walon ke liye bana hai - isse niryatkar ko aasan suvidha milti hai.

qe: Which organization regulates the 'Insurance' sector in India?
qh: भारत में 'बीमा' क्षेत्र को कौन नियंत्रित करता है?
e: Bharat mein bima kshetra ka niyaman tatha vikas ka kaam bima niyaman tatha vikas pradhikaran yaani IRDAI karta hai. Pehle vikalp mein IRDAI ka niyaman ki baat sahi kahi gayi hai. Yah alag pradhikaran isliye banayi gayi ki bima tatha bank ka karobar alag tarah ka hota hai; isliye IRDAI bima companyon ke niyam, grahakon ki suraksha tatha claims ke kaam par nazar rakhti hai. SEBI share bazaar dekhta hai, RBI bankon tatha mudra ko sambhalta hai tatha LIC khud ek bima company hai, isliye inmein koi niyamak nahi hai. IRDAI ka niyaman ke alawa baaki sab vikalp galat hain. Exam point: bima kshetra ko IRDAI niyantrit karta hai - yahi bima companyon par nazar rakhta hai.

qe: What is the primary purpose of 'Basel Norms' in the banking sector?
qh: बैंकिंग क्षेत्र में 'बेसल मानदंडों' (Basel Norms) का प्राथमिक उद्देश्य क्या है?
o: To ensure banks have enough capital to handle risks
e: Basel maryada yaani Basel Norms aise niyamon ka samooh hai jo bankon ke paas kam se kam punji tatha jokhim sambhalne ki taakat honi chahiye, yah tay karte hain. Pehle vikalp mein basel ke punji niyam ki baat sahi kahi gayi hai. Yah niyam isliye banaye gaye ki bank ke doobne se poora paisa bazaar hil jaata hai; isliye bankon ko apni karz ke jokhim ke hisaab se punji rakhni padti hai, jisse sankat ke samay wo khud ko sambhal sakein. Naya paisa chhapna tatha byaj dar badhana in maryadaon ke kaam nahi hain tatha koi nahi wala vikalp galat hai. basel ke punji niyam ke alawa baaki sab vikalp galat hain. Exam point: basel maryadaon ka maksad bankon ke paas kaafi punji rakhwana hai - isse bank jokhim sambhal paate hain.

qe: What does 'CAR' (Capital Adequacy Ratio) represent?
qh: 'CAR' (पूंजी पर्याप्तता अनुपात) क्या दर्शाता है?
o: Bank's capital to its risk-weighted assets
e: CAR yaani punji paryapta anupat batata hai ki bank ki apni punji uske jokhim-wale asseton ke muqable kitni hai. Pehle vikalp mein CAR ka anupat ki baat sahi kahi gayi hai. Yah anupat isliye dekha jaata hai ki bank ke paas jo karz diye gaye hain unmein se kuch doob bhi sakte hain; isliye karobar ke jokhim ke hisaab se apni punji rakhne par hi bank surakshit mana jaata hai. Jama tatha karz ka anupat tatha kul labh ka anupat is shabd se alag hain tatha koi nahi wala vikalp galat hai. CAR ka anupat ke alawa baaki sab vikalp galat hain. Exam point: CAR bank ki punji tatha jokhim wali sampatti ka anupat hai - isse bank ki taakat ka pata chalta hai.

qe: In the context of Indian banking, what is 'MCLR'?
qh: भारतीय बैंकिंग के संदर्भ में 'MCLR' क्या है?
o: Marginal Cost of Funds based Lending Rate
e: MCLR yaani Marginal Cost of Funds based Lending Rate wo sabse kam byaj dar hai jisse neeche bank apne grahakon ko karz nahi de sakte, tatha yah dar bank ke dhan jodne ki laagat par tay hoti hai. Teesre vikalp mein MCLR wali byaj dar ko sahi bataya gaya hai. Yah dar isliye laayi gayi ki pehle base rate bazaar ki halchal ka poora asar grahakon tak nahi pahunchata tha; isliye MCLR se repo rate badalne ka asar grahakon ke karz par tezi se padne laga. Maximum Credit Limit Rate, koi nahi tatha Minimum Cash Loan Rate jaise naam is dar ke nahi hain. MCLR wali byaj dar ke alawa baaki sab vikalp galat hain. Exam point: MCLR bank ke karz dene ki sabse kam dar hai - yahi aaj grahakon ke byaj ka aadhar hai.

qe: Why did RBI move from MCLR to 'EBLR' (External Benchmark Lending Rate)?
qh: RBI ने MCLR से 'EBLR' की ओर रुख क्यों किया?
o: To ensure faster transmission of repo rate changes to borrowers
e: EBLR yaani External Benchmark based Lending Rate wo dar hai jismein bank apne karz ki dar seedhe repo rate jaisi baahar ki bench-mark se jod dete hain; RBI ne MCLR chhodkar isi raste ko chuna. Chauthe vikalp mein bench-mark wali EBLR dar ki baat sahi kahi gayi hai. Yah badlav isliye kiya gaya ki MCLR mein repo rate ghatne ka labh grahakon tak dhire pahunchta tha; isliye ab repo rate badalte hi nayi tatha purani karz ki dar tezi se badalti hai, jisse grahakon ko turant rahat milti hai. Digital banking rokna tatha bank ka labh badhana is badlav ke kaam nahi hain tatha koi nahi wala vikalp bhi galat hai. bench-mark wali EBLR dar ke alawa baaki sab vikalp galat hain. Exam point: EBLR ka rasta repo rate ka asar grahakon tak tez pahunchata hai - yahi iski badi khoobi hai.

qe: What is the 'Full Form' of IBC in the Indian Economy?
qh: भारतीय अर्थव्यवस्था में 'IBC' का पूर्ण रूप क्या है?
e: IBC ka poora naam Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code hai, tatha yah kanoon doobte karobar tatha logon ke karz ka samadhan ek tay samay mein karane ke liye laaya gaya tha. Doosre vikalp mein IBC wale kanoon ka vistrit naam theek bataya gaya hai. Yah kanoon isliye ahem hai ki pehle karz dene walon ko apna paisa wapas paane mein saalon lag jaate the; isliye ab karz ka faisla ek samay-seema mein hota hai tatha kamzor karobar ko band karne ya bachane ka rasta saaf ho jaata hai. International Business Commission, Indian Banking Code tatha koi nahi wale naam is kanoon ke sahi nahi hain. IBC wale kanoon ka vistrit naam ke alawa baaki sab vikalp galat hain. Exam point: IBC ka poora naam Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code hai - yahi doobte karz ka samadhan ka kanoon hai.

qe: Under the IBC, who is responsible for the 'Resolution Process' of a corporate debtor?
qh: IBC के तहत, कॉर्पोरेट देनदार की समाधान प्रक्रिया के लिए कौन जिम्मेदार होता है?
e: IBC ke tahat karobar ka samadhan chalane ka kaam ek Insolvency Professional yaani IP karta hai, jo doobti company ke kaam-kaaj tatha karz dene walon ki baithak ko sambhalta hai. Doosre vikalp mein Insolvency Professional ki baat sahi kahi gayi hai. Yah vyakti isliye ahem hai ki ushe adalat ki manzuri milti hai tatha wo sabhi pakshon ka bharosa jeetkar kamzor company ko bechne ya bachane ka rasta nikalta hai. Police, koi nahi tatha RBI gavarnar is kaam ke sahi naam nahi hain, isliye karobar sambhalne ka zimmewar koi bhi inmein nahi hai. Insolvency Professional ke alawa baaki sab vikalp galat hain. Exam point: IBC ka samadhan kaam Insolvency Professional chalata hai - yahi poore karobar ka rasta dekhta hai.

qe: What is 'Haircut' in the context of debt recovery?
qh: कर्ज वसूली के संदर्भ में 'हेयरकट' (Haircut) क्या है?
o: The percentage of the loan amount that a lender agrees to forgo
e: Karz vasooli mein haircut ka matlab hai ki karz dene wala jis rakam ko chhod dene par raazi ho jaata hai, taaki baaki paisa aur kam waqt mein wapas mil jaye. Chauthe vikalp mein haircut ki kataai ki baat sahi kahi gayi hai. Yah kataai isliye hoti hai ki doobti company se poora paisa wapas nahi milta; isliye bank tatha anya karzdar thoda nuksan sahkarke bacha hua paisa le lete hain, jisse unka karobar chalta rahe tatha karz ka bojh halka ho. Koi nahi, naai ki chhoot tatha poora bhugtan is shabd ke sahi matlab nahi hain. haircut ki kataai ke alawa baaki sab vikalp galat hain. Exam point: haircut mein karz ka kuch hissa chhodna padta hai - yahi doobte karz ka samadhan hota hai.

qe: What is the 'Prompt Corrective Action' (PCA) framework?
qh: 'त्वरित सुधारात्मक कार्रवाई' (PCA) ढांचा क्या है?
o: RBI's watch-list for weak banks with poor financial health
e: PCA yaani tvarit sudharatmak karyavahi ek rekh-aankalan hai jisse RBI un bankon ko chihnit karti hai jinki punji, karz ki haalat tatha labh kamzor ho gaye hain. Teesre vikalp mein PCA ki soochi ki baat sahi kahi gayi hai. Yah soochi isliye banayi gayi ki kamzor bankon par samay rahte sakht niyam lagaye jayein; isliye aise bankon ke naye karz dene tatha shaakhaayein kholne par rok lag jaati hai, jisse wo apni haalat sudhar sakein. Muft karz ki manzuri, koi nahi tatha kar choron ke khilaf karyavahi is shabd ke sahi nahi hain. PCA ki soochi ke alawa baaki sab vikalp galat hain. Exam point: PCA kamzor bankon ki soochi hai - isliye ismein aaye bankon par sakht niyam lagte hain.

qe: What is 'Standing Deposit Facility' (SDF) introduced by RBI?
qh: RBI द्वारा शुरू की गई 'स्थायी जमा सुविधा' (SDF) क्या है?
o: A tool to absorb liquidity without providing collateral to banks
e: SDF yaani sthira jama suvidha ek aisa cholha hai jismein RBI bankon ka bacha hua paisa bina kisi girvi ke apne paas jama kar leti hai. Teesre vikalp mein SDF wali jama suvidha ki baat sahi kahi gayi hai. Yah rasta isliye banaya gaya ki bazaar mein paisa bahut zyada hone par mehngai ka khatra badhta hai; isliye SDF se paisa kheenchkar taralta kam ki jaati hai tatha bankon ko kam se kam girvi rakhne ki zarurat nahi padti. Locker ki sewa, lambi avadhi ka karz tatha koi nahi wale vikalp is cholhe ke kaam ke nahi hain. SDF wali jama suvidha ke alawa baaki sab vikalp galat hain. Exam point: SDF se RBI bina girvi paisa kheench leti hai - yahi iska bada fayda hai.

qe: What is 'Monetary Policy Transmission'?
qh: 'मौद्रिक नीति संचरण' (Monetary Policy Transmission) क्या है?
o: The process by which RBI's rate changes affect the market interest rates
e: Maudrik niti sancharan yaani Monetary Policy Transmission ka matlab hai wo rasta jisse RBI ki byaj dar mein badlav bankon ki dar tatha aam grahakon ke karz par asar dikhata hai. Pehle vikalp mein policy transmission ki baat sahi kahi gayi hai. Yah sancharan isliye ahem hai ki repo rate ghatne par bhi agar bank apni dar nahi ghatate to aam aadmi ko koi labh nahi milta; isliye EBLR tatha anya upayon se yah rasta tez kiya gaya, jisse karobar tatha khapat par asar pade. Videsh paisa bhejna, koi nahi tatha note chhapna is shabd ke sahi matlab nahi hain. policy transmission ke alawa baaki sab vikalp galat hain. Exam point: Monetary Policy Transmission yaani maudrik niti sancharan ka rasta tez karna RBI ka bada lakshya hai.

qe: What is 'Central Bank Digital Currency' (CBDC) in India?
qh: भारत में 'सेंट्रल बैंक डिजिटल करेंसी' (CBDC) क्या है?
o: Digital form of the Indian Rupee issued by RBI
e: CBDC yaani kendriya bank digital mudra RBI dwara jaari ki gayi rupaye ka digital roop hai, jo noto ki tarah sarkar ka vaada maanta hai. Pehle vikalp mein CBDC ka roop ki baat sahi kahi gayi hai. Yah mudra isliye laayi gayi ki digital bhugtan tez hokar sasta ho tatha har lenden ka hisaab sarkar ke paas rahe; isliye yah niji crypto mudra se alag hai, kyunki iske peeche RBI ka bharosa hota hai tatha iski keemat sthir rehti hai. Niji cryptocurrency, koi nahi tatha Bitcoin jaise naam is mudra ke sahi nahi hain. CBDC ka roop ke alawa baaki sab vikalp galat hain. Exam point: CBDC rupaye ka digital roop hai jise RBI jaari karti hai - yahi sarkari digital mudra hai.

qe: What is a 'Regulatory Sandbox'?
qh: 'रेगुलेटरी सैंडबॉक्स' क्या है?
o: A framework for live testing of new financial products in a controlled environment
e: Regulatory sandbox ek aisa bandobast hai jismein naye financial tareeqon ko ek seemit tatha nigrani wale daayre mein aazma kar dekha jaata hai. Doosre vikalp mein regulatory sandbox ki baat sahi kahi gayi hai. Aisa daayra isliye khada kiya gaya ki naya kaam laate samay kal ke grahakon tatha sarkari niyamon ko nuksan na pahunche; isliye josh wali companyon ko kam samay tatha kam paise mein nayi seva parakhne ka mauka milta hai. Kar daftar, khel ka maidan tatha koi nahi wale vikalp is shabd ke sahi matlab nahi hain. regulatory sandbox ke alawa baaki sab vikalp galat hain. Exam point: regulatory sandbox naye tareeqon ki aazmaish ka daayra hai - isse josh wali companyon ko mauka milta hai.

qe: What is the maximum overall 'Time Limit' for resolving a case under CIRP (including legal delays)?
qh: CIRP के तहत मामला सुलझाने की अधिकतम समय सीमा (कानूनी देरी सहित) क्या है?
e: CIRP yaani samadhan ki prakriya ki samnvay seema kul 330 din hai, jismein kanoon ki deri bhi shaamil hai. Doosre vikalp mein CIRP wala 330 din samay ki baat sahi kahi gayi hai. Aisi seema isliye baandhi gayi ki lamba muqadma karz dene walon ka paisa tatha karobar dono band kar deta hai; isliye 180 din ke buniyadi samay mein samadhan tatha aadha saal tak ki kanoon ki deri, is tarah kul milakar 330 din ka rasta chuna gaya. Paanch saal, sau assi din tatha nabbe din is seema ke sahi nahi hain. CIRP wala 330 din samay ke alawa baaki sab vikalp galat hain. Exam point: CIRP ki samnvay seema kul 330 din hai - isse doobte karobar ka faisla samay par hota hai.

qe: What is 'Bad Bank' (NARCL)?
qh: 'बैड बैंक' (NARCL) क्या है?
o: An entity created to buy bad loans from other banks to clean their balance sheets
e: NARCL yaani rastriya asset punarnirman company ek bad bank hai jo doosre bankon ke doobte karz khareed leti hai, taaki unke khate saaf ho jayein. Doosre vikalp mein doobte karz khareedne wali NARCL ki baat sahi kahi gayi hai. Doobte karz khareedne wali yah vyavastha isliye banayi gayi ki lakho crore ka doobta karz bankon ki karz dene ki kshamta kha jaata hai; isliye bad bank alag khadi hui, jisse bank apni asli karobar par dhyan de sakein tatha doobte karz ka samadhan ek hi jagah se ho jaye. Apradhiyon ka bank, koi nahi tatha chori karne wala bank jaise vikalp is shabd ke sahi nahi hain. doobte karz khareedne wali NARCL ke alawa baaki sab vikalp galat hain. Exam point: NARCL doobte karz khareedne wali bad bank hai - isse bankon ke khate saaf hote hain.

qe: What is 'Sterilization' by RBI?
qh: RBI द्वारा 'स्टेरलाइजेशन' (Sterilization) क्या है?
o: Absorbing excess liquidity caused by large foreign capital inflows
e: Sterilization ka matlab hai videshi paise ke bahav se badhi hui taralta ko yaani bazaar se paisa khenchkar sahi karna, taaki mehngai na badhe. Chauthe vikalp mein sterilization ka kaam ki baat sahi kahi gayi hai. Jab videshi niveshkar badi matra mein punji laate hain to rupee aur bazaar mein paisa badh jaata hai; isliye RBI sarkari kagaz bechkar wahi paisa khench leti hai, jisse mudra ki matra sahi rehti hai. Nakad paisa saaf karna, sone ki keemat tay karna tatha koi nahi wale vikalp is shabd ke kaam nahi hain. sterilization ka kaam ke alawa baaki sab vikalp galat hain. Exam point: sterilization se videshi punji ke bahav ka asar sambhala jaata hai - isse mehngai par lagam rehti hai.

qe: What is the 'Operative Target' of RBI's monetary policy?
qh: RBI की मौद्रिक नीति का 'ऑपरेटिव टारगेट' क्या है?
e: RBI ki maudrik niti ka operative target WACR yaani bhara-laga ausat call rate hota hai, jise repo rate ke aas-paas rakha jaata hai. Chauthe vikalp mein WACR ki baat sahi kahi gayi hai. Yah lakshya isliye chuna jaata hai ki bankon ke aapas ke chhote samay wale karz ka asli dar bazaar ki haalat batata hai; isliye WACR ko repo ke dayare mein rakhne se RBI ki niti sahi tarike se lagu hoti hai. Sone ki keemat, share ka soochi tatha koi nahi wale vikalp is lakshya ke sahi nahi hain. WACR ke alawa baaki sab vikalp galat hain. Exam point: RBI ki niti ka operative target WACR hai - yahi bazaar ki asli dar dikhata hai.

qe: What is the 'Minimum Capital' required for a new universal bank to start operations in India?
qh: भारत में नया यूनिवर्सल बैंक शुरू करने के लिए न्यूनतम पूंजी की क्या आवश्यकता है?
e: Bharat mein naya universal bank shuru karne ke liye kam se kam paanch sau crore rupaye ki punji rakhni padti hai, tatha iske liye RBI se manzuri leni hoti hai. Teesre vikalp mein 500 crore ki punji ki baat sahi kahi gayi hai. Yah shart isliye rakhi gayi ki universal bank bade paimane par jama sweekar karta tatha karz deta hai; isliye itni badi punji rakhne se bank ke paas shuru se hi maya ka sahara hota hai. Sau crore, hazaar crore tatha koi nahi wale vikalp is kam se kam punji ke sahi nahi hain. 500 crore ki punji ke alawa baaki sab vikalp galat hain. Exam point: universal bank ke liye 500 crore ki punji chahiye - yahi uski shuruat ki badi shart hai.

qe: What was the 'JAM' Trinity conceptualized for in India?
qh: JAM ट्रिनिटी का उपयोग किसलिए किया जाता है?
e: JAM trinity ka matlab hai Jan Dhan khaata, Aadhaar tatha Mobile - tatha iska mukhya istemal seedha labh hastantaran ke zariye sarkari yojanaon ka paisa logon tak pahunchana hai. Teesre vikalp mein JAM trinity ki baat sahi kahi gayi hai. Yah tigdi isliye kaam aayi ki pehle sahayata beech wale kharch kar jaate the; isliye khaate, pahchan tatha mobile ke jodne se paisa seedha labh-arthi ke khaate mein aata hai tatha fake naam kam ho jaate hain. Manoranjan, koi nahi tatha antriksh yatra wale vikalp JAM ke kaam ke sahi nahi hain. JAM trinity ke alawa baaki sab vikalp galat hain. Exam point: JAM trinity se yojnaon ka paisa seedha khaate mein pahunchta hai - yahi DBT ka aadhar hai.

qe: What is the standard 'Priority Sector Lending' (PSL) target for domestic commercial banks?
qh: वाणिज्यिक बैंकों के लिए 'प्राथमिकता प्राप्त क्षेत्र ऋण' (PSL) का लक्ष्य क्या है?
e: PSL yaani priority sector lending ka maksad bankon ke karz ka ek tay hissa un kshetron mein pahunchana hai jahan aam karobar se paisa nahi jaata, jaise kheti, chhote udyog tatha kamzor varg; isliye vyaaparik bankon ka lakshya ANBC yaani samayojit shuddh bank credit ka 40 pratishat hota hai. Pehle vikalp mein samayojit shuddh bank credit ka 40 pratishat sahi bataya gaya hai. Yah lakshya isliye tay hua ki desh ki aadhi se zyada aabadi kisaano tatha chhote karobar par tiki hai; isliye isi seema se vikas tatha aay ka santulan banta hai tatha kamzor vargon tak sasta karz pahunchta hai. Pachchis pratishat tatha das pratishat ka aakda bahut kam hai tatha pachaas pratishat bahut zyada, isliye yah seemayein PSL ke asli lakshya se nahi milti. Baaki teen vikalp is lakshya se hatt kar hain. Exam point: PSL ka lakshya ANBC ka 40 pratishat hai - jismein kheti ka 18 pratishat alag tay hota hai.

qe: What is 'Negative Interest Rate' policy adopted by some central banks?
qh: 'नकारात्मक ब्याज दर' (Negative Interest Rate) नीति क्या है?
o: When central banks charge commercial banks for parking excess reserves
e: Nakaratmak byaj dar yaani Negative Interest Rate ka matlab hai ki kendriya bank bankon ke paas jama zyada paise par unse shulk ya byaj vasoolta hai, yaani unhe paisa apne paas rakhne ki saja milti hai; isliye bank woh paisa bazaar mein karz dene mein lagate hain tatha khapat badhane ki koshish hoti hai. Doosra vikalp sahi hai, jo jama par bankon se byaj vasoolne wali baat likhta hai. Yah tarika tab apnaya jaata hai jab mehngai bahut kam ho tatha karobar thanda pade; isliye bankon ko jama par nuksan dikhakar unhe karz dene tatha nivesh badhane ke liye prerit kiya jaata hai. Koi nahi, saari karz par sun byaj tatha ghar ke karz par oonchi dar wale vikalp nakaratmak dar ke sahi nahi hain, isliye ve yahan nahi baithe. Ise chhodkar baaki vikalp is vishay se door hain. Exam point: nakaratmak byaj dar mein bank ko paisa jama rakhne par nuksan hota hai - isse khapat badhane ka purjhor hota hai.

qe: Which body publishes the bi-annual 'Financial Stability Report' (FSR) in India?
qh: भारत में 'वित्तीय स्थिरता रिपोर्ट' (FSR) कौन जारी करता है?
e: Vittiya sthirta riporat yaani Financial Stability Report RBI chhaapti hai, jismein desh ke bankon tatha poore vitta bazaar ki jokhim wali haalat ka aankalan hota hai. Vittiya sthirta riporat jaari karna hi sahi hai, jo doosre vikalp mein likha hai. Ise RBI isliye nikaalti hai ki junta tatha niti banane walon ko bankon ki taakat, doobte karz tatha bazaar ke khatron ki sahi jaankari mile; isliye sankat se pehle hi jagrukta badhti hai. SEBI, NITI Aayog tatha vitta mantralaya alag alag kshetron ke kaam dekhte hain, isliye FSR inmein se koi nikaalta nahi. Sirf yahi riporat sahi hai, baaki vikalp galat. Exam point: Financial Stability Report RBI jaari karti hai - ismein bankon ki jokhim bhari haalat batayi jaati hai.

qe: What is 'Universal Banking'?
qh: 'यूनिवर्सल बैंकिंग' (Universal Banking) क्या है?
o: Providing all financial services (Insurance, Shares, Loans) under one roof
e: Universal banking ka matlab hai ki ek hi bank ke andar bank, bima, share daalar tatha anya vittiye sevaayein ek hi chhat ke neeche di jaayein; isliye grahak ko kaee daftaron ke chakkar nahi lagane padte. Teesra vikalp sahi hai kyunki wahi ek hi chhat ke neeche saari vittiye sevaayein batata hai. Yah tarika isliye aage badha ki bade bank ke paas grahak jod tatha gunjit kaam karne ki taakat thi; isliye ve ek jagah se saari suvidha dene lage. Antariksh banking, koi nahi tatha sirf baahar ke deshon wala karobar - ye teeno is tarike se mel nahi khaate. In teeno baaki vikalpon ka is tarike se koi taalluk nahi. Exam point: Universal banking mein saari vittiye sevaayein ek hi bank se milti hain - yahi iski badi pehchan hai.

qe: What is 'Offshore Banking'?
qh: 'ऑफशोर बैंकिंग' (Offshore Banking) क्या है?
o: Banking services located outside the country of residence of the depositor
e: Offshore banking aise bank ke karobar ko kaha jaata hai jo us desh ke baahar hota hai jahan jama-karta rehta hai, tatha aise karobar par kam niyam tatha kam kar lagte hain. Pehla vikalp sahi hai, jo jama-karta ke desh se baahar ka karobar dikhata hai. Yah tarika isliye bana ki videshi niveshkar tatha niryatkar ko apne desh ke sakht niyamon se alag ek aasan jagah chahiye thi; isliye unke paise kam rok-tok ke saath rakhe tatha kamaye jaate hain. Jahazon par banking, koi nahi tatha gaon-wale kshetra ka karobar - ye teeno is karobar ke sahi roop nahi hain. Baaki vikalp is karobar ke sahi roop nahi hain. Exam point: Offshore banking jama-karta ke desh se baahar chalne wala karobar hai - ise kam niyam wala bazaar kaha jaata hai.

qe: What is 'Financial Repression' in macroeconomic policy?
qh: 'वित्तीय दमन' (Financial Repression) क्या है?
o: Policies that result in savers earning returns below inflation
e: Vittiya dafan yaani Financial Repression aisi sarkari niti ko kaha jaata hai jismein bachat karta ya niveshkar ki byaj mehngai se kam rehti hai; isliye aam aadmi ka asli munaafa khatm ho jaata hai. Teesre vikalp mein bachat ki byaj mehngai se kam rakhna sahi kaha gaya hai. Yah haalat isliye banti hai ki sarkar sasta karz chahti hai; isliye dar ko jaan-boojhkar kam rakhne se bachat ki keemat ghatti hai tatha bankon ko sarkari kagaz kharidne par majboori si hoti hai. Koi nahi, bank daketi tatha share bazaar band karna jaise vikalp is dhaarna ke sahi nahi hain, isliye ve galat hain. Ise chhodkar baaki vikalp is dhaarna ke nahi baithte. Exam point: vittiya dafan mein bachat ki byaj mehngai se kam rakhi jaati hai - isse bachatkarta nuksan mein rehta hai.

qe: What is the 'Countercyclical Capital Buffer' (CCyB)?
qh: 'काउंटर-साइक्लिकल कैपिटल बफर' (CCyB) क्या है?
o: Requirement for banks to hold more capital during economic booms
e: Counter-cyclical capital buffer yaani CCyB ek aisa niyam hai jismein bankon ko tez badhotri ke daur mein apni punji zyada rakhni padti hai, taaki mandi aane par wahi punji kaam aaye. Teesra vikalp sahi hai, jo tez badhotri ke daur mein zyada punji rakhne ki baat karta hai. Aisa niyam isliye banta hai ki tez chal rahi arthvyavastha mein bank zyada karz dete hain tatha khatra badh jaata hai; isliye buum mein punji jodkar mandi ke samay use khola jaata hai. Locker ka shulk, mandi mein lagaya sarkari kar tatha koi nahi wale vikalp is niyam ke sahi nahi hain, isliye ve galat hain. Baaki teen vikalp is niyam se mel nahi khaate. Exam point: CCyB tez badhotri ke daur mein bankon se zyada punji rakhwata hai - isse mandi ka bojh sambhala jaata hai.

qe: What is the 'National Automated Clearing House' (NACH)?
qh: 'NACH' क्या है?
o: A centralized system for bulk high-volume electronic transactions
e: NACH yaani National Automated Clearing House ek kendrit vyavastha hai jo bankon ke beech badi matra mein aane wale electronic bhugtan tatha karz ki kishton ko apne aap nikalne ka kaam karti hai. Doosra vikalp sahi hai, jo badi matra ke electronic bhugtan ka kendrit manch batata hai. Yah vyavastha isliye laayi gayi ki sarkari yojnaon ka paisa tatha karz ki kist laakhon khaaton tak samay par pahunchani thi; isliye ek hi aadesh se hazaaron bhugtan ek saath ho jaate hain. Sarkari skool, koi nahi tatha kaagaz ke cheque ki hat-wali clearing - ye teeno is manch ke sahi roop nahi hain. Sirf yahi manch sahi hai, baaki vikalp galat. Exam point: NACH badi matra ke electronic bhugtan ka apne-aap chalne wala manch hai - isse kist tatha sahayata samay par pahunchti hai.

qe: What does 'Net Interest Margin' (NIM) measure for a bank?
qh: बैंक के लिए 'शुद्ध ब्याज मार्जिन' (NIM) क्या है?
o: Difference between interest income earned and interest expense paid relative to assets
e: Shuddh byaj marjin yaani NIM bank ki byaj se kamaye paise tatha byaj par diye paise ke phark ko uski kul sampatti ke saath naapkar batata hai. Teesre vikalp mein byaj ki kamai tatha byaj ke kharch ka phark sahi likha gaya hai. Yah anupat isliye ahem hai ki bank ka asli munaafa karz dena tatha jama lena ke beech ke phark se hi banta hai; isliye ise dekhkar pata chalta hai ki bank ka karobar kitni kushalta se chal raha hai. Tankha ka kharch, koi nahi tatha kul karz ki rakam is naap ke sahi nahi hain, isliye ve galat hain. Baaki vikalp is naap ke muqable theek nahi baithte. Exam point: NIM byaj ki kamai tatha byaj ke kharch ka phark batata hai - isse bank ki karobar ki samajh milti hai.

qe: What is the 'Full Form' of NPCI in digital banking?
qh: डिजिटल बैंकिंग में NPCI का 'पूर्ण रूप' क्या है?
e: NPCI yaani National Payments Corporation of India ek aisi company hai jise RBI tatha bankon ne milkar banaya, tatha yahi UPI, RuPay tatha NACH jaise manch chalati hai. Pehla vikalp sahi hai kyunki wahi payments ka rastriya nigam batata hai. Yah sanstha isliye banayi gayi ki chhote bhugtan ka poora network ek jagah se sambhala ja sake; isliye desh ka har bank iske manch se juda hai tatha digital bhugtan sasta tatha tez hua. New Payment Code India, National Payment Council of India tatha koi nahi wale vikalp is poore naam ke sahi nahi hain, isliye ve galat hain. In teeno baaki vikalpon ka is nigam se koi rishta nahi. Exam point: NPCI ka poora naam National Payments Corporation of India hai - yahi UPI tatha RuPay ki jad hai.

qe: What is 'Legal Tender' money?
qh: 'वैध मुद्रा' (Legal Tender Money) क्या है?
o: Currency notes and coins that a creditor must accept by law to settle a debt
e: Vaidh mudra yaani Legal Tender Money aise note tatha sikke hote hain jinko karz chukane ke liye lena kanuni taur par zaroori hota hai; yaani koi vyakti kanuni mudra ko bhugtan ke liye thukra nahi sakta. Teesra vikalp sahi hai, jo bhugtan ke liye kanuni majboori wali mudra batata hai. Yah vyavastha isliye zaroori hai ki desh mein ek hi bharosemand bhugtan ka zariya ho; isliye sarkar ki jaari ki hui mudra ko sabhi lenden mein sweekar kiya jaata hai. Digital inaam ke point, cheque tatha daastavej is shabd ke sahi nahi hain, kyunki cheque lena kanuni majboori nahi hoti. Baaki vikalp is mudra ke sahi roop nahi hain. Exam point: vaidh mudra wahi hai jise kanun ke tahat bhugtan mein lena padta hai - ismein note tatha sikke aate hain.

qe: What was the 'Base Rate' system in Indian banking?
qh: बैंकिंग में 'बेस रेट' क्या था?
o: Minimum benchmark interest rate below which banks were not permitted to lend
e: Base rate bank ke karz dene ki wo sabse kam dar thi jisse neeche karobar karna bankon ke liye mana tha, tatha yah dar RBI ke niyam ke hisaab se tay hoti thi. Chauthe vikalp mein karz dene ki sabse kam dar ki seema sahi batayi gayi hai. Aise niyam ka maksad yah tha ki pehle grahakon ko bahut mehange karz milte the; isliye ek seema tay karke bankon ko sasti dar par karz dene ke liye majboor kiya gaya. Koi nahi, RBI ka aam janta ko karz dena tatha jama par tay dar wale vikalp base rate ke sahi nahi hain, isliye ve galat hain. Ise chhodkar baaki vikalp is seema ke nahi milte. Exam point: base rate karz dene ki sabse kam dar ki seema thi - ise baad mein MCLR ne badal diya.

qe: What is the 'Incremental Capital Output Ratio' (ICOR)?
qh: 'वृद्धिशील पूंजी उत्पादन अनुपात' (ICOR) क्या है?
o: Amount of capital investment needed to produce one additional unit of output
e: ICOR yaani vriddhishil punji utpadan anupat batata hai ki ek extra ikai utpadan badhane ke liye kitni punji lagani padti hai; isliye yah aakda desh ki nivesh ki kushalta dikhata hai. Teesre vikalp mein ek ikai utpadan ke liye lagni wali punji sahi likhi gayi hai. ICOR ko isliye dekha jaata hai ki iska kam hona kam paise mein zyada utpadan dikhata hai; isliye yojna banane walon ke liye yah sabse ahem naap hai. Kar tatha labh ka anupat, kul karz ka anupat tatha koi nahi wale vikalp is naap ke sahi nahi hain, isliye ve galat hain. Baaki teen vikalp is anupat se alag hain. Exam point: ICOR ek ikai utpadan ke liye lagni wali punji batata hai - kam ICOR desh ki taakat dikhata hai.

qe: What is 'MICR' code used for in banking?
qh: बैंकिंग में 'MICR' कोड का क्या उपयोग है?
o: Automated processing and clearance of paper cheques
e: MICR yaani Magnetic Ink Character Recognition aise khaas chhapai wale ankon ki pehchan hai jo cheque ke neeche chhape hote hain tatha machine se padhe jaate hain. Teesra vikalp sahi hai, jo cheque ke neeche chhape khaas anka ki pehchan batata hai. Yah khaas chhapai isliye ki gayi ki cheque ka faisla tez tatha bina galti ho; isliye MICR line se hi cheque apne bank tatha shaakha tak pahunchkar jaldi clear ho jaata hai. Mobile recharge, ATM login tatha koi nahi wale vikalp is khaas chhapai ke kaam ke sahi nahi hain, isliye ve galat hain. Sirf yahi pehchan sahi hai, baaki vikalp galat. Exam point: MICR cheque ke neeche chhape khaas anka ki pehchan hai - isse cheque ki safai tez hoti hai.

qe: What is 'M4' money supply in India?
qh: भारत में 'M4' मुद्रा आपूर्ति क्या है?
e: M4 mudra aapurti ka sabse bada naap hai, jismein M3 ke saath dak-ghar ki kul jama bhi jodi jaati hai; isliye yah desh mein paise ki sabse chaudi maatra dikhata hai. Chauthe vikalp mein M3 ke saath dak-ghar ki kul jama jodne ki baat sahi hai. Ise sabse chauda naap isliye kaha jaata hai ki ismein chalan wala paisa, bachat jama tatha dak-ghar ke bachat khate sab shaamil hain; isliye isse tayyar kul paise ka andaaza lagta hai. Keval chalan wala paisa, M1 ke saath sona tatha koi nahi wale vikalp M4 ke sahi sootr nahi hain, isliye ve galat hain. Baaki vikalp is sootr ke hisaab se theek nahi. Exam point: M4 ka sootr M3 plus dak-ghar ki kul jama hai - yahi mudra aapurti ka sabse bada naap hai.

qe: What does the 'Liquidity Coverage Ratio' (LCR) mandate for banks?
qh: बैंकिंग में 'तरलता कवरेज अनुपात' (LCR) क्या है?
o: Holding sufficient High-Quality Liquid Assets to survive a 30-day severe stress scenario
e: LCR yaani taralta cover anupat batata hai ki bank ke paas sabse achhi taralta wali sampatti kitni hai, jisse wo 30 din ke sakht sankat ko jhel sakta hai. Teesra vikalp sahi hai, jo 30 din ke sakht sankat ke liye taralta ka naap batata hai. Aisi seema isliye tay hui ki bank ke paas aise paise chahiye jo turant bik sakein; isliye is anupat se pata chalta hai ki bura waqt aane par bank khud ko sambhal sakta hai ya nahi. ATM ki rashi ki seema, koi nahi tatha labh ka anupat is shabd ke sahi nahi hain, isliye ve galat hain. In teeno baaki vikalpon ka is naap se koi mel nahi. Exam point: LCR 30 din ke sakht sankat ke liye taiyar taralta ka naap hai - isse bank ki safai ki taakat dikhti hai.

qe: What is 'Tier-1 Capital' in banking?
qh: बैंकिंग में 'टियर-1 पूंजी' क्या है?
o: Core equity capital including disclosed reserves and common shares
e: Tier-1 punji bank ki asli core punji hoti hai, jismein uska khula bhandaar tatha aam share shaamil hote hain, tatha isi par sankat jhelne ki sabse badi taakat tiki hoti hai. Chauthe vikalp mein khula bhandaar tatha aam share wali core punji sahi thehrayi gayi hai. Yah punji isliye alag pehchani jaati hai ki karz tatha anya jama se bani punji sankat mein jaldi khatm ho jaati hai; isliye niyam banane wale asli core punji ko sabse bharosemand maante hain. Koi nahi, gaadi ke karz ka kosh tatha locker ka shulk is punji ke sahi hisse nahi hain, isliye ve galat hain. Baaki vikalp is punji ke sahi hisse nahi hain. Exam point: Tier-1 punji bank ki core punji hoti hai - yahi sabse bharosemand punji mani jaati hai.

qe: What is 'Tokenization' in card-based digital payments?
qh: कार्ड-आधारित डिजिटल भुगतान में 'टोकनाइजेशन' (Tokenization) क्या है?
o: Replacing actual card details with a unique alternative code
e: Tokenization mein asli card ke ank hataakar unki jagah ek khaas badla ank tay kiya jaata hai, jo keval usi dukaan tatha usi device ke saath judta hai. Teesra vikalp sahi hai, jo asli card ke ank ki jagah badla khaas ank batata hai. Yah tarika isliye laaya gaya ki kahin bhi card ke asli ank chori na ho jayein; isliye chori hone par bhi asli card ka ank surakshit rehta hai tatha badle ank se bhugtan ho jaata hai. Koi nahi, naya card chhapna tatha nakli sikke dena is shabd ke sahi nahi hain, isliye ve galat hain. Ise chhodkar baaki vikalp is tarike ke nahi hain. Exam point: tokenization card ke asli ank ko badle khaas ank se badalta hai - isse card ka ank surakshit rehta hai.

qe: What is a 'Digital Banking Unit' (DBU)?
qh: 'डिजिटल बैंकिंग यूनिट' (DBU) क्या है?
o: Fixed brick-and-mortar outlet providing specialized self-service digital banking
e: DBU yaani digital banking unit wo pakki jagah wala bank ka kaam karne wala darwaza hai jahan grahak khud hi machine tatha screen se digital bank ki suvidha lete hain. Pehla vikalp sahi hai, jo pakki jagah wali khud se digital suvidha dikhata hai. Yah soch isliye aage badhi ki aam shaakha ki bhid tatha kaagaz ka kaam ghat sake; isliye kam karmchari hone par bhi sau tarah ki suvidha ek hi jagah milti hai. Koi nahi, ATM ka kamra tatha locker ka kamra is soch ke sahi nahi hain, isliye ve galat hain. Baaki teen vikalp is kendra ke sahi roop nahi. Exam point: DBU ek pakki jagah wali digital suvidha ka kendra hai - yahi khud se bank ka kaam karne ka naya rasta hai.

qe: Who issues one-rupee notes and coins in India?
qh: भारत में एक रुपये के नोट और सिक्के कौन जारी करता है?
o: Ministry of Finance (signed by Finance Secretary)
e: Bharat mein ek rupaye ka note tatha saare sikke vitta mantralaya jaari karta hai, tatha ek rupaye ke note par vitta sachiv apna hastakshar lagate hain. Doosra vikalp sahi hai kyunki vitta mantralaya dwara jaari ek rupaye ka note wahi batata hai. Yah baant isliye hai ki sikke tatha ek rupaye ka note sarkar ke seedhe niyantran mein maane gaye; isliye inki chhapai tatha jaari karne ka kaam mantralaya karta hai, jabki baaki note RBI chhaapti hai. Gavarnar, pradhan mantri tatha rashtrapati ke naam is jaise chhapai ke kaam se jude nahi hain, isliye ve galat hain. Sirf yahi jaari karta sahi hai, baaki teen vikalp galat. Exam point: ek rupaye ka note aur sabhi sikke mantralaya se nikalte hain - RBI ke haath se nahi.

qe: Which of the following is a 'Qualitative' tool of RBI credit control?
qh: क्रेडिट को नियंत्रित करने के लिए RBI का 'गुणात्मक' (Qualitative) उपकरण कौन सा है?
e: Moral suasion yaani naitik salah ek gunatmak yaani Qualitative upkaran hai, jismein RBI bankon ko khushi se hidaayat deti hai ki tez karz dena kam karein; isliye yah upkaran kanoon se nahi, samjhane se chalta hai. Teesra vikalp sahi hai, jo bankon ko samjhakar disha dene wali baat karta hai. Iska fayda isliye hai ki ginti wale upkaranon se har baar khatra theek nahi hota; isliye RBI bankon ko samjha-bujha kar tatha unke saath baithkar karz ko sahi disha deti hai. Repo rate, CRR tatha bank rate ginti wale upkaran hain jo paise ki matra tatha dar ko seedha badalte hain, isliye ve gunatmak ke nahi hain. Ise chhodkar baaki vikalp is upkaran ke nahi hain. Exam point: moral suasion ek gunatmak upkaran hai - ismein RBI bankon ko samjhakar disha deti hai.

qe: What is 'Velocity of Money'?
qh: 'मुद्रा का वेग' (Velocity of Money) क्या है?
o: The average rate at which money changes hands in an economy
e: Mudra ka veg yaani Velocity of Money batata hai ki desh mein maujood paisa ek tay samay mein kitni baar ek haath se doosre haath mein jaata hai; isliye kam paise se hi zyada karobar ho jaata hai. Pehla vikalp sahi hai, jo paise ke haath badalne ki raftaar batata hai. Yah naap isliye dekha jaata hai ki paise ka chhota chaal hi tez karobar dikhata hai; isliye jitna tez paisa badalta hai, utna hi badhotri tatha mehngai par asar padta hai. Byaj dar, videshi mudra ka dar tatha note chhapne ki raftaar is naap ke sahi nahi hain, isliye ve galat hain. In teeno baaki vikalpon ka is raftaar se koi taalluk nahi tha. Exam point: mudra ka veg paise ke haath badalne ki raftaar hai - tez veg zyada karobar dikhata hai.

qe: When was the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) nationalized?
qh: भारतीय रिजर्व बैंक (RBI) का राष्ट्रीयकरण कब हुआ था?
e: Bharatiye rizarv bank yaani RBI ka rashtriy karan ek January 1949 mein hua, jab uske saare hissedaaron ke share sarkar ne le liye; isliye wah ek sarkari sanstha ban gayi. Teesra vikalp sahi hai, jo 1949 mein hue rashtriy karan ko dikhata hai. Yah kadam isliye liya gaya ki aazadi ke baad desh ki mudra tatha bankon ka niyaman sarkar ke haath mein ho; isliye RBI ke saare share sarkar ke naam kar diye gaye. 1947 yaani aazadi ka saal, 1935 yaani RBI ke banne ka saal tatha 1955 yaani SBI ke banne ka saal is rashtriyakaran ke sahi saal nahi hain. Baaki vikalp is saal ke sahi nahi hain. Exam point: RBI ka rashtriy karan 1949 mein hua tha - yah aazadi ke baad ka bada vitta kadam tha.

qe: In which year were 14 major commercial banks first nationalized in India?
qh: भारत में 14 प्रमुख वाणिज्यिक बैंकों का राष्ट्रीयकरण किस वर्ष किया गया था?
e: Bharat mein chaudah bade vyaaparik bankon ka rashtriy karan 1969 mein hua, tatha uske baad 1980 mein chhe aur bankon ka hua. Chauthe vikalp mein 1969 mein chaudah bankon ka rashtriyakaran sahi likha hai. Yah kadam isliye liya gaya ki bade bankon ke karz keval bade karobar tatha saahukaar tak pahunchte the; isliye sarkar ne unhe apne adhikar mein lekar gaon tatha kisaano tak bank suvidha pahunchai. 1950 yaani yojna ka shuru, 1991 yaani audarikaran ka saal tatha 1980 yaani doosre charan ka saal is pehle rashtriyakaran ke sahi saal nahi hain. Ise chhodkar baaki vikalp is saal se mel nahi khaate. Exam point: pehla bada rashtriy karan 1969 mein hua - ismein chaudah bade bank shaamil the.

qe: What is the full form of 'NEFT'?
qh: 'NEFT' का पूर्ण रूप क्या है?
e: NEFT yaani National Electronic Funds Transfer ek poore desh ka aisa manch hai jismein bank kisi bhi samay paisa ek khaate se doosre khaate mein bhej sakte hain. Chauthe vikalp mein har samay paisa bhejne wala desh-bhar ka manch sahi bataya gaya hai. Yah manch isliye ahem hai ki ek hi jagah se chhote tatha bade bhugtan sabhi samay jaari rehte hain; isliye karobar tatha sahayata ka paisa pal bhar mein doosre kone tak pahunch jaata hai. Koi nahi, National External Fund Transfer tatha New Electronic Fund Trust jaise naam is manch ke sahi nahi hain, isliye ve galat hain. Baaki teen vikalp is manch ke sahi naam nahi. Exam point: NEFT ka poora naam National Electronic Funds Transfer hai - isse har samay paisa bheja ja sakta hai.

qe: What is 'Hot Money'?
qh: 'हॉट मनी' (Hot Money) क्या है?
o: Short-term capital moving quickly across markets seeking quick profits
e: Hot money yaani garam paisa wo videshi paisa hai jo tez munaafe ke liye thode samay mein ek desh se doosre desh mein aata-jaata rehta hai. Chauthe vikalp sahi hai, jo tez munaafe ke liye bhaagte videshi paise ko batata hai. Yah paisa isliye khatarnak maana jaata hai ki munaafa kam dikhne par yah pal bhar mein nikal jaata hai; isliye iske aane-jaane se rupaye ki keemat tatha bazaar mein hulchul badh jaati hai. Kala dhan, nakli note tatha naya chhapa paisa is shabd se bilkul alag hain, isliye ye teeno galat hain. Sirf yahi paisa sahi hai, baaki vikalp galat. Exam point: hot money tez munaafe ke liye bhaagta rehne wala videshi paisa hai - yahi bazaar mein hulchul paida karta hai.

qe: What is the primary function of 'EXIM Bank' of India?
qh: 'एक्जिम बैंक' (EXIM Bank) का मुख्य कार्य क्या है?
o: Financing, facilitating, and promoting Foreign Trade
e: Ekjim bank yaani EXIM Bank ka mukhya kaam desh ka videshi vyapar badhana hai, tatha yah niryat tatha aayat dono ke liye karz tatha suvidha deta hai. Doosra vikalp sahi hai kyunki videshi vyapar ke liye karz dena wahi dikhata hai. Yah bank isliye khada kiya gaya ki aam vyaaparik bank videshi vyapar ke lambe tatha jokhim bhare karz se jhijhakte the; isliye EXIM Bank sarkar ke samarthan se yah kaam sambhalta hai. Kheti ka karz, chhote udyog tatha sheher ka vikas anya sansthaon ke kaam hain, isliye ye EXIM Bank ke sahi kaam nahi hain. Baaki vikalp is kaam ke sahi roop nahi hain. Exam point: EXIM Bank videshi vyapar ke liye karz tatha suvidha deta hai - yahi iska mukhya kaam hai.

qe: What is 'Balance of Payments' (BoP)?
qh: 'भुगतान संतुलन' (BoP) क्या है?
o: Comprehensive record of all economic transactions between residents of a country and the rest of the world
e: Bhugtan santulan yaani BoP desh ke logon tatha baaki duniya ke bich hone wale sabhi aarthik lenden ka poora hisaab hai, jismein chalu khaata tatha punji khaata shaamil hote hain. Chauthe vikalp sahi hai, jo nivasiyon tatha duniya ke sabhi lenden ka hisaab batata hai. Yah hisaab isliye ahem hai ki videshi vyapar tatha punji ke aane-jaane se rupaye ki keemat par asar padta hai; isliye ghata hone par desh ko videshi karz ya sampatti bechne par majboori padti hai. Bank ka khaata, kar ka hisaab tatha koi nahi wale vikalp is hisaab ke sahi nahi hain, isliye ve galat hain. In teeno baaki vikalpon ka is hisaab se koi rishta nahi. Exam point: BoP desh tatha baaki duniya ke beech ke sabhi lenden ka hisaab hai - ismein chalu tatha punji khaata aate hain.

qe: What is the standard 'Fiscal Year' period in the Republic of India?
qh: भारत में 'राजकोषीय वर्ष' (Fiscal Year) की अवधि क्या है?
e: Bharat ka rajkoshiy varsh yaani Fiscal Year ek April se lekar ekatti March tak ka hota hai; isi avadhi ke sabhi aay tatha kharch ek hi budget ke andar aate hain. Doosra vikalp sahi hai, jismein April se March wali avadhi likhi hai. Yah avadhi isliye chuni gayi ki fasal ke kaam tatha kar vasooli ka hisaab isi tarah milta hai; isliye saal ka shuru basant ke mausam mein tatha ant March mein hota hai. October se September, January se December tatha July se June wali avadhiyan is desh ke rajkoshiy varsh se mel nahi khati. Baaki teen vikalp is avadhi ke nahi milte. Exam point: rajkoshiy varsh April se March tak ka hota hai - budget ka poora hisaab isi saal ka hota hai.

qe: Which major indirect tax system subsumed VAT, Central Excise, and Service Tax in India?
qh: माल और सेवा कर (GST) द्वारा किन करों को प्रतिस्थापित किया गया था?
o: VAT, Central Excise, and Service Tax
e: GST yaani maal tatha seva kar ek July 2017 se laagu kiya gaya, tatha usne VAT, kendriya utpad shulk tatha seva kar jaisi kaee choti badi kar ko ek hi kar mein badal diya. Teesra vikalp sahi hai, jo VAT, Central Excise tatha Service Tax batata hai. Yah ek kar ka tarika isliye laaya gaya ki pehle har rajya ka apna kar tha tatha ek saaman par kaee baar kar lagta tha; isliye ek desh ek kar se vyapar aasan tatha sasta hua. Corporate Tax tatha Income Tax aay par lagne wale kar hain tatha Customs Duty aayat par lagta hai, isliye inmein se koi GST mein nahi samaaya. Baaki vikalp un purane karon ke sahi nahi hain. Exam point: GST ne VAT, kendriya utpad shulk tatha seva kar ko apne andar sama liya - yahi iski badi pehchan hai.

qe: What is 'Disinvestment' in public finance?
qh: 'विनिवेश' (Disinvestment) क्या है?
o: Liquidation or sale of government equity stake in Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs)
e: Vinivesh yaani Disinvestment ka matlab hai sarkar apni hisse wali company yaani PSU mein apna kuch hissa bechkar paisa jutana; isliye sarkar ka adhikar kam hota hai tatha bazaar mein share aate hain. Pehla vikalp sahi hai, jo PSU mein sarkari hisse ki bikri dikhata hai. Yah raasta isliye chuna jaata hai ki aam niveshkar bhi sarkari companyon mein hissa le sakein tatha company ka kaam sudhre; isliye paisa yojnaon tatha sakht kaam ke liye milta hai. Videshi seedha nivesh, poori company band karna tatha nayi company mein paisa lagana alag vishay hain, isliye ye vinivesh ke sahi nahi hain. Baaki teen vikalp is vishay ke nahi baithe. Exam point: vinivesh mein sarkar PSU ka kuch hissa bechti hai - company band nahi hoti, balki bazaar mein aati hai.

qe: What constitutes 'Capital Expenditure' in a government budget?
qh: बजट में 'पूंजीगत व्यय' क्या है?
o: Expenditure that creates physical assets or reduces financial liabilities
e: Poonjgat vyay wo kharch hota hai jisse nayi sampatti banti hai, jaise sadak, pul tatha karkhane, ya jisse sarkari karz kam hota hai; isliye yah bhavishya mein aay badhane wala kharch mana jaata hai. Doosra vikalp sahi hai, jo sampatti banane ya karz ghatane wale kharch ko dikhata hai. Is kharch ko alag isliye dekha jaata hai ki yah saal-dar-saal aay paida karta rehta hai; isliye budget mein ise badhana desh ke vikas ki nishani mana jaata hai. Byaj dene ka bhugtan, karmchariyon ka tankha tatha khapat par di jaane wali sahuliyat rajasy vyay ke hisse hain, isliye ye poonjgat vyay nahi hain. Baaki vikalp is kharch ke sahi nahi baithte. Exam point: poonjgat vyay se sampatti banti hai ya karz ghatta hai - yahi iski asli pehchan hai.

qe: What is 'Revenue Deficit' in fiscal accounting?
qh: 'राजस्व घाटा' क्या है?
o: Excess of total revenue expenditure over total revenue receipts
e: Rajasy ghata wo phark hai jo sarkar ki kul rajasy praptiyon se kul rajasy vyay nikaalne par bachta hai; isliye yah batata hai ki sarkar apne roz-marra ke kharch ke liye kitna karz leti hai. Teesra vikalp sahi hai, jo kul rajasy vyay tatha kul rajasy prapti ka phark batata hai. Is ghate ko dekhna isliye zaroori hai ki yah sarkar ke rozana ke kharch tatha aay ke beech ki gadbad dikhata hai; isliye ise ghatane ke liye kharche ya kar ke jariye paisa badhana padta hai. Kul rashtriy karz, vyapar ka ghata tatha koi nahi wale vikalp is phark ke sahi nahi hain. Baaki teen vikalp is hisaab se mel nahi khaate. Exam point: rajasy ghata rajasy vyay tatha rajasy prapti ka phark hai - yahi roz-marra ke ghat ka naap hai.

qe: Who serves as the ex-officio 'Chairman' of the GST Council?
qh: GST काउंसिल का 'अध्यक्ष' कौन होता है?
e: GST parishad ki adhyakshta kendra ke vitta mantri karte hain, tatha is parishad mein sabhi rajyon ke vitta mantri tatha kendra ke rajasy mantri shaamil hote hain. Teesra vikalp sahi hai, jo kendra ke vitta mantri ko adhyaksh batata hai. Yah parishad isliye banayi gayi ki ek hi kar ko laagu karne ke liye kendra tatha rajyon ki saanjha salah zaroori thi; isliye iske nirnay do-tihai bahumat se hote hain. RBI gavarnar, NITI Aayog ke mukhya executive tatha pradhan mantri is parishad ke adhyaksh ke sahi naam nahi hain. Baaki vikalpon ka is kursi se koi naata nahi hai. Exam point: GST parishad ke adhyaksh kendra ke vitta mantri hote hain - gavarnar tatha pradhan mantri nahi.

qe: What is a 'Cess' in the Indian taxation framework?
qh: कराधान के संदर्भ में 'सेस' (Cess) क्या है?
o: An earmarked tax on tax levied for a specific public purpose
e: Ses yaani Cess ek aisa kar hota hai jise kisi ek khaas kaam ke liye lagaya jaata hai tatha usi kaam par kharch kiya jaata hai, jaise shiksha ses ya swachh bharat ses. Teesra vikalp sahi hai, jo khaas maksad wale kar ko batata hai. Is kar ko alag isliye rakha jaata hai ki uski vasooli ka paisa khaas kaam ke liye surakshit rahe; isliye ses ka paisa rajyaon ke saath baantne wale aam hisse mein nahi jaata. Aam salahi kar, koi nahi tatha aayat par lagne wala mahsool is khaas kar ke sahi nahi hain. Baaki teen vikalp is kar ke sahi roop nahi. Exam point: ses kisi khaas kaam ke liye lagne wala alag kar hai - iska paisa usi kaam par kharch hota hai.

qe: Which constitutional article mandates the presentation of the 'Annual Financial Statement' (Budget)?
qh: संविधान का कौन सा अनुच्छेद केंद्रीय बजट से संबंधित है?
e: Sanvidhan ke anuchhed 112 ke tahat kendra sarkar har saal sansad ke saamne varshik vittiye vivran rakhti hai, jise aam bhasha mein kendra ka budget kaha jaata hai. Pehla vikalp sahi hai kyunki anuchhed 112 hi kendra ke budget ka aadhar hai. Yah anuchhed isliye ahem hai ki sarkar ki saari aay tatha kharch ki tafseel ki manzuri jan-pratinidhiyon se lena zaroori hai; isliye bina iske ek rupaya bhi khaate se nahi nikal sakta. Anuchhed 280 vitta ayog ke baare mein hai, anuchhed 360 vittiye aapda ke baare mein tatha anuchhed 110 dhan vidheyak ke baare mein hai. Baaki anuchhed is budget ke nahi hain. Exam point: kendra ka budget anuchhed 112 ke tahat aata hai - wahi varshik vittiye vivran hai.

qe: What is 'Deficit Financing'?
qh: 'घाटे की वित्त व्यवस्था' क्या है?
o: Bridging the budget gap through borrowings or drawing down cash balances
e: Ghate ki vitt vyavastha ka matlab hai budget ke ghate ko karz lekar ya sarkari khaate ki bachat ke nakad paise se poora karna; isliye naye kar ke bina hi kharch chalta rehta hai. Pehla vikalp sahi hai, jo karz ya nakad bachat se ghata bharne ki baat karta hai. Yah tarika sarkar isliye apnaati hai jab turant kaam tatha kharch badhana ho; isliye agar hadh se zyada karz liya jaye to mehngai tatha karz ka bojh badh jaata hai. Mahsool ghatana, koi nahi tatha kharch kaati wale vikalp ghate ki vitt vyavastha ke sahi nahi hain. Baaki vikalp is vishay ke sahi nahi baithe. Exam point: ghate ki vitt vyavastha mein karz ya jama nakad se ghata bhara jaata hai - yahi sarkar ka aakhri sahara hota hai.

qe: What does the 'Laffer Curve' illustrate?
qh: 'लाफ़र कर्व' (Laffer Curve) किससे संबंधित है?
