o: The theoretical relationship between tax rates and total tax revenue collected
e: Laafar vakra yaani Laffer Curve kar ki dar tatha kul kar vasooli ke beech ke sambandh ko dikhata hai; isliye yah batata hai ki bahut oonchi kar dar levan par bhi vasooli ghat sakti hai. Teesra vikalp sahi hai, jo kar dar tatha kul kar vasooli ka sambandh batata hai. Yah vichar isliye ahem hai ki bahut zyada kar lagane par log kar dena chhod dete hain tatha kaam dhanda chhipaane lagte hain; isliye ek seema ke baad kar dar badhane se vasooli ghatne lagti hai. Mehngai tatha naukri, videshi mudra ke anupat tatha garibi ke aakde is vakra ke sahi vishay nahi hain. Baaki vikalp is vakra ke nahi hain. Exam point: Laafar vakra kar dar tatha vasooli ka sambandh dikhata hai - bahut oonchi dar par vasooli ghatati hai.

qe: What is 'Direct Benefit Transfer' (DBT)?
qh: 'प्रत्यक्ष लाभ हस्तांतरण' (DBT) क्या है?
o: Electronic transfer of subsidies directly into verified bank accounts of beneficiaries
e: Pratyaksh labh hastantaran ka matlab hai sarkari sahayata ya riyayat ka paisa seedha labh-arthi ke bank khaate mein bhejna; isliye beech ke log tatha fake naam ka rasta band ho jaata hai. Pehla vikalp sahi hai, jo verified khaaton mein seedha paisa bhejne ki baat karta hai. Yah tarika isliye laaya gaya ki pehle saaman tatha paisa beech ke haathon se guzarta tha tatha uski chori hoti thi; isliye ab khaate ki pahchan ke baad hi paisa nikalta hai. Gaon mein rasad dukaanein kholna, koi nahi tatha anaaj baantna purane tarike hain, isliye ye DBT ke sahi nahi hain. Ise chhodkar baaki vikalp is badlav se alag hain. Exam point: DBT mein sahayata ka paisa seedha bank khaate mein aata hai - isse fake naam tatha chori ghatti hai.

qe: Who is historically regarded as the 'Father of Modern Economics'?
qh: 'अर्थशास्त्र का जनक' किसे कहा जाता है?
e: Adam Smith duniya ke pehle bade aarthik vichaarak the, tatha unki kitaab The Wealth of Nations ne deshon ki daulat tatha bazaar ke kaam karne ka naya tarika samjhaya; isliye unhe is vishay ke pehle guru ke roop mein yaad kiya jaata hai. Chauthe vikalp mein Adam Smith ka naam sahi likha hai. Yah pad unhe isliye mila ki unse pehle aarthik vichaar bikhre tatha adhure the; isliye unki baaton ne aage aane wale sabhi aarthik vichaaron ki neev rakhi. John Maynard Keynes, Karl Marx tatha Alfred Marshall bade aarthik vichaarak hain par unhe janak nahi kaha jaata. Baaki vikalp is pad ke haqdaar nahi hain. Exam point: Adam Smith ki pehchan unki kitaab The Wealth of Nations hai - unhe is vishay ka pehla bada guru maana jaata hai.

qe: Which sector makes the largest sectoral contribution to India's Gross Domestic Product (GDP)?
qh: भारत की जीडीपी में किस क्षेत्र का योगदान सबसे अधिक है?
e: Bharat ki GDP mein sabse bada hissa sevaon wale teesre kshetra ka hota hai, jismein bank, bima, vyapar, transport tatha IT jaise kaam aate hain. Chauthe vikalp mein sevaon wale teesre kshetra ko sahi jagah di gayi hai. Yah hissa isliye sabse bada ban gaya ki kheti tatha karkhane se zyada naukriyan tatha kamai ab sevaon mein badh rahi hain; isliye shehron mein badhti aabadi isi kshetra ko taakat deti hai. Kheti wala pehla kshetra, khanan tatha factory wala doosra kshetra isse kam hissa dete hain, isliye ye sabse bade hisse ke sahi nahi hain. Baaki teen vikalp is hisse se peeche hain. Exam point: sevaon wale teesre kshetra ka hissa GDP mein sabse zyada hai - yahi bharat ki arthvyavastha ki khaas baat hai.

qe: How is 'Real GDP' differentiated from 'Nominal GDP'?
qh: 'वास्तविक जीडीपी' (Real GDP) क्या है?
o: Evaluated at constant base year prices, stripped of inflationary distortion
e: Vastavik GDP yaani Real GDP wo naap hai jismein desh ke utpadan ko ek tay aadhaar saal ki keematon par nikaala jaata hai, isliye mehngai ke chaadhaav ka asar hata diya jaata hai. Pehla vikalp sahi hai, jo aadhaar saal ki keematon par ginne ki baat karta hai. Yah tarika isliye zaroori hai ki chalu keematon par ginne se mehngai bhi badhotri jaisi dikhti hai; isliye asli badhotri dhoondhne ke liye ek hi saal ki keematein pakad li jaati hain. Koi nahi, dhatu ka bhandar tatha chalu keematon par ki gayi ginti is naap ke sahi nahi hain. Baaki vikalp is naap ke sahi nahi. Exam point: vastavik GDP aadhaar saal ki keematon par nikaala jaata hai - isse mehngai ka asar hat jaata hai.

qe: Which agency releases official GDP and National Income statistics in India?
qh: भारत में 'राष्ट्रीय आय' की गणना कौन करता है?
e: Bharat mein rashtriy aay ka hisaab rastriya saankhyiki karyalaya yaani National Statistical Office nikaalta hai, tatha yah kaam pahle kendriya saankhyiki sangathan karta tha. Chauthe vikalp mein National Statistical Office ko sahi thehraya gaya hai. Yah karyalaya isliye ahem hai ki iske aakde sarkar ki niti tatha duniya ke aage desh ki haalat rakhte hain; isliye GDP, mehngai tatha rozgaar ke bade naap iske hi kaam hain. NITI Aayog salah deta hai, RBI bank tatha mudra dekhta hai tatha vittiye sevaon ka vibhag yojnaon ka paisa dekhta hai, isliye inmein koi hisaab nikaalne wala nahi hai. Baaki teen vikalp is kaam ke nahi hain. Exam point: rashtriy aay ka hisaab National Statistical Office nikaalta hai - yahi desh ke bade aakde jaari karta hai.

qe: What does 'Purchasing Power Parity' (PPP) adjust for when comparing international economies?
qh: 'पीपीपी' (PPP) क्या है?
o: Exchange rates adjusted for differences in domestic price levels and living costs
e: Kharid shakti samanta ka matlab hai desh ki mudra ko aise badalna jismein vaise hi saaman tatha seva ke liye do deshon mein barabar kharch ho; isliye yah keval bazaar ke dar se alag hota hai. Pehla vikalp sahi hai, jo keematon tatha rehne ke kharch ke phark ke hisaab se dar batata hai. Yah naap isliye kaam aata hai ki gareeb tatha ameer deshon ke rehne ke kharch alag hote hain; isliye GDP ko isi dar se jodkar tulna ki jaati hai. Koi nahi, sarkar tatha niji company ke theke tatha share ki keemat ka soochak is naap ke sahi nahi hain. Baaki vikalp is dar ke nahi baithe. Exam point: PPP wala dar keematon tatha rehne ke kharch ke phark ke hisaab se hota hai - isse deshon ki tulna sahi hoti hai.

qe: What does a 'Lorenz Curve' graphically map?
qh: 'लॉरेंज कर्व' का उपयोग किसके लिए किया जाता है?
o: Cumulative distribution of national income or wealth inequality
e: Lorenz vakra kisi desh ki aay ya daulat ka baantwara dikhane wali line hai, jismein abadi tatha aay ka hissa ek saath chadhkar dikhaya jaata hai. Chauthe vikalp sahi hai, jo aay tatha daulat ke baantware ki kadwa dikhata hai. Yah vakra isliye banaya jaata hai ki barabar tatha atyadhik gadbad wali haalat ka phark saaf dikhe; isliye jo vakra seedhi line se jitna door hoga, utni hi zyada asamaanata hogi. Kar vasooli tatha dar, videshi mudra ki halchal tatha berozgari tatha mehngai - ye sab is vakra ke vishay nahi hain. Baaki teen vikalp is vakra mein nahi aate. Exam point: Lorenz vakra aay tatha daulat ke baantware ko dikhata hai - iske door hatne ka matlab zyada asamaanata hai.

qe: What does a 'Gini Coefficient' of 0 denote?
qh: 'गिनी गुणांक' (Gini Coefficient) में 0 का मान क्या दर्शाता है?
e: Gini gunank yaani Gini Coefficient asamaanata ka aakda hai; ismein shunya ka matlab hai sab logon ki aay barabar hai tatha ek ka matlab hai saari aay ek hi ke paas hai. Chauthe vikalp sahi hai, jo poorn samanta ko dikhata hai. Yah numainda aakda isliye kaam aata hai ki kam sankhya mein hi poori tasveer saaf ho jaati hai; isliye deshon ki tulna karne ke liye isi gunank ko dekha jaata hai. Tej mehngai, poora aarthik dhaancham girna tatha sabse zyada asamaanata is aakde ke sahi matlab nahi hain. Baaki teen vikalp is aakde ke sahi nahi. Exam point: Gini gunank mein shunya barabari tatha ek poora phark dikhata hai - kam aakda behtar maana jaata hai.

qe: How can the RBI intervene directly in spot forex markets to arrest a sharp slide in the Rupee?
qh: आरबीआई रुपये की तेज गिरावट को रोकने के लिए कैसे हस्तक्षेप कर सकता है?
o: By slashing the policy Repo Rate
By selling US Dollars from foreign exchange reserves to supply market demand
e: Rupaye ki tez girawat rokne ke liye RBI apne videshi mudra bhandar se dollar bazaar mein bechti hai; isliye dollar ki aapurti badhti hai tatha rupaye ki keemat sambhalti hai. Chauthe vikalp sahi hai, jo bhandar se dollar bechne ki baat karta hai. Girawat rokne ka yah upay isliye chalta hai ki jab bahut log rupaya chhodkar dollar lete hain to rupaya girta hai; isliye bazaar mein dollar daalne se uski kimmat ka dabaav kam ho jaata hai. Policy repo rate ghatana, zyada note chhapna tatha niryat par rok is girawat ko rokne ke sahi raaste nahi hain, kyunki inse rupaya aur kamzor ho sakta hai. Baaki vikalp is raaste ke nahi hain. Exam point: RBI bhandar se dollar bechkar rupaye ko sambhalti hai - yahi uski sabse badi bazaar mein daav ki pehchan hai.

qe: What operational mechanism does the RBI deploy during 'Open Market Operations' (OMO) to drain system liquidity?
qh: जब आरबीआई बाजार में तरलता कम करना चाहता है, तो 'ओपन मार्केट ऑपरेशंस' (OMO) में क्या होता है?
o: RBI sells government securities into the open banking market
e: Khule bazaar ke kaam mein jab RBI bazaar ki taralta ghatana chahti hai to wo apne paas ki sarkari kagaz bechti hai; isliye bankon ka paisa kheench liya jaata hai tatha bazaar mein paisa kam ho jaata hai. Pehla vikalp sahi hai, jo sarkari kagaz bechne ki baat karta hai. Iska asar isliye hota hai ki sarkari kagaz kharidne par bank ka paisa RBI ke paas jama ho jaata hai; isliye chahe taralta badhani ho ya ghatani ho, dono ke liye yahi rasta istemal hota hai. Shaakhaayein band karne ka aadesh, sarkari kagaz kharidna tatha company par lagne wale kar mein kaati is kaam ke sahi nahi hain. Baaki teen vikalp is tarike ke nahi hain. Exam point: OMO mein taralta ghatane ke liye RBI sarkari kagaz bechti hai - kharidne par taralta badhti hai.

qe: Which institution maintains and administers the 'Rural Infrastructure Development Fund' (RIDF)?
qh: ग्रामीण बुनियादी ढांचा विकास कोष (RIDF) का रखरखाव और प्रबंधन कौन सी संस्था करती है?
e: Gramin buniyadi dhaanche vikas kosh NABARD ke paas rakha jaata hai, tatha iska paisa un bankon se aata hai jo gaon-wale karz ka lakshya poora nahi kar paate. Doosra vikalp sahi hai, jo NABARD ko is kosh ka sambhalne wala batata hai. Yah kosh isliye banaya gaya ki gaon ki sadak, sinchai tatha godaam jaise kaam ke liye paisa mile; isliye karz ke kam aakde wale bankon ka paisa isi khaas kosh mein jama hota hai. SBI, RBI tatha SEBI is kosh ke rakhe walon ke sahi naam nahi hain. Baaki vikalp is kosh ke nahi hain. Exam point: RIDF ko NABARD sambhalti hai - iska paisa gaon ke buniyadi kaam par lagta hai.

qe: What regulatory ceiling is placed on deposit accounts in 'Payments Banks' in India?
qh: भारत में 'पेमेंट्स बैंकों' पर जमा स्वीकार करने की क्या सीमा है?
o: Demand deposits accepted up to Rs. 2 lakh per individual customer
e: Payments bank grahak se jama paisa le sakte hain par har grahak ke liye maang jama ki seema do lakh rupaye hai; isliye bade jama tatha bade karz ka kaam ye bank nahi karte. Doosra vikalp sahi hai, jo do lakh rupaye ki seema batata hai. Aisi seema isliye rakhi gayi ki payments bank chhote bhugtan tatha bachat ke khaate par dhyan dein; isliye inhe karz dena tatha bade jama lena mana hai. Bina kisi seema ke jama, pachaas lakh ki jama tatha koi jama na lena - ye teeno is seema ke sahi nahi hain. Baaki teen vikalp is seema se bahar hain. Exam point: payments bank mein maang jama ki seema do lakh rupaye hai - isse zyada jama nahi ho sakti.

qe: What is the mandatory tenure of sovereign investment under the 'Sovereign Gold Bond' (SGB) Scheme?
qh: परिपक्वता के लिए 'सॉवरेन गोल्ड बॉन्ड' (SGB) की कुल अवधि क्या है?
e: Sovereign gold bond ki kul avadhi aath saal ki hoti hai, tatha ismein niveshkar paanch se aath saal ke beech samay se pehle bhi paisa nikaal sakta hai; isliye yah sone mein nivesh ka aasan rasta hai. Doosra vikalp sahi hai, jo aath saal ki avadhi batata hai. Yah bond isliye laaya gaya ki aam log sone ki jewellery ke bajaye kagaz wale sone mein paisa lagayein; isliye unhe thoda byaj bhi milta hai tatha desh ka sone ka aayat kam hota hai. Paanch saal, teen saal tatha pandrah saal wali avadhiyan is bond ke sahi nahi hain. Baaki vikalp is avadhi ke nahi hain. Exam point: SGB ki kul avadhi aath saal hoti hai - paanchve saal ke baad samay se pehle nikalne ka mauka milta hai.

qe: What enforcement power does the 'SARFAESI Act, 2002' grant secured lenders?
qh: 'सरफेसी अधिनियम, 2002' बैंकों को क्या करने का अधिकार देता है?
o: Seize and auction pledged immovable securities of defaulting debtors without prior court intervention
e: Sarfaesi adhiniyam do hazaar do ke tahat bank bina adalat jaaye girvi rakhi sampatti apne kabze mein lekar bech sakte hain; isliye doobta karz vasooley ka yah tez rasta hai. Chauthe vikalp sahi hai, jo adalat ki dakhalandaji ke bina jaaydad kabze karne ki baat karta hai. Yah adhikar isliye diya gaya ki karz wapas na hone par bank saalon tak adalat ke chakkar mein na pare; isliye poora suchna dene ke baad wo sampatti kabze mein lekar bechkar apna paisa nikaal lete hain. Aparadhi muqadme ladna, aapda ki mudra chhapna tatha kheti ka poora karz maaf karna is adhiniyam ke kaam nahi hain. Baaki vikalp is adhikar ke nahi hain. Exam point: SARFAESI 2002 bank ko adalat ke bina girvi sampatti bechne ka adhikar deta hai - yahi doobta karz vasooley ka tez rasta hai.

qe: The 'Indradhanush' mission announced in 2015 focused on:
qh: सरकार द्वारा 'इंद्रधनुष' (Indradhanush) योजना (2015) किसके लिए शुरू की गई थी?
o: Comprehensive revamp, capitalization, and governance overhaul of Public Sector Banks
e: Indradhanush yojna do hazaar pandrah mein sarvajanik kshetra ke bankon ko sudharne, unki punji badhane tatha unke kaam ki nigrani sudharne ke liye laayi gayi thi. Pehla vikalp sahi hai, jo sarvajanik bankon ke sudhar ka poora kaam batata hai. Yah yojna isliye laayi gayi ki sarkari bankon ka doobta karz tatha kam punji chinta ka vishay ban gaya tha; isliye ek saath kaee sudhar ke kadam rakhe gaye. Nadiyon ko jodna, saamarthya sheher ki imaarat tatha sirf bachon ka teekakaran is yojna ke kaam nahi hain. Baaki teen vikalp is yojna ke nahi hain. Exam point: Indradhanush yojna 2015 mein sarkari bankon ke sudhar ke liye laayi gayi - punji badhana iska bada hissa tha.

qe: Which statutory board regulates insolvency professionals and processes under the IBC in India?
qh: भारत में 'दिवाला और दिवालियापन संहिता' (IBC) के लिए नियामक निकाय कौन सा है?
o: Insolvency and Bankruptcy Board of India (IBBI)
e: Divale tatha divaliyapan sanhita ke kaam ko dekhne wala niyamak nikay Insolvency and Bankruptcy Board of India hai, tatha isi sanhita ke tahat karobar ka samadhan hota hai. Pehla vikalp sahi hai kyunki IBBI hi is sanhita ka niyamak hai. Yah nikay isliye banaya gaya ki doobte karobar ka samadhan ek jagah se tatha ek samay-seema mein ho; isliye samadhan karne walon tatha aakalan karne wali sansthaon ki nigrani yahi karta hai. Vidhi ayog kanoon par salah deta hai, SEBI share bazaar dekhta hai tatha NITI Aayog niti ki salah deta hai, isliye inmein koi niyamak nahi hai. Baaki vikalp is kaam ke nahi hain. Exam point: IBC ka niyamak Insolvency and Bankruptcy Board of India hai - yahi samadhan ki nigrani karta hai.

qe: What was the date of the historic mega-merger of SBI's five associate banks and Bharatiya Mahila Bank into SBI?
qh: एसबीआई के सहयोगी बैंकों का भारतीय स्टेट बैंक में विलय किस तारीख को हुआ?
e: SBI ke sahayogi bankon tatha Bharatiye Mahila Bank ka SBI mein vilay ek April do hazaar satrah ko hua tha, tatha iske baad desh ka sabse bada bank aur bada ho gaya. Pehla vikalp sahi hai, jo pehli April 2017 ki tareekh batata hai. Yah vilay isliye kiya gaya ki chhote sahayogi bankon ki laagat tatha kamzori door ho; isliye ek hi bade bank ke andar saari shaakhaayein tatha grahak aa gaye. Pahli January 2015, pandrah August 2019 tatha do October 2020 ki tareekhein is vilay ki sahi nahi hain. Baaki vikalp is tareekh ke nahi hain. Exam point: SBI ke sahayogi bankon ka vilay ek April 2017 ko hua - isse SBI desh ka sabse bada bank bana.

qe: What does the government's '4Rs' bank recapitalization strategy represent?
qh: सार्वजनिक क्षेत्र के बैंकों की सफाई के लिए '4Rs' रणनीति का क्या अर्थ है?
e: Sarvajanik bankon ki safai ke liye 4R ka matlab hai Recognition yaani dikkat pehchanana, Resolution yaani samadhan, Recapitalisation yaani punji dena tatha Reforms yaani sudhar. Doosra vikalp sahi hai, jo chaar sahi shabd batata hai. Yah chaar kadam isliye tay kiye gaye ki pehle dikkaton ko chhupaaya jaata tha tatha paisa kam padta tha; isliye pehle samasya maan lena, phir samadhan, punji tatha sudhar ka rasta chuna gaya. Kiraya, dar tatha vasooli jaise kaam ke kram, kachre ko dobara istemal karne wale shabd tatha padhne-likhne wale shabd is kram ke sahi nahi hain. Baaki teen vikalp is kram ke nahi hain. Exam point: 4R ka matlab Recognition, Resolution, Recapitalisation tatha Reforms hai - yahi sarkari bankon ki safai ka kram hai.
